powers.name: Accelerated Healing
powers.effect: Any healing or regeneration received is doubled; also regenerates 1 1st Deg wound per round.
powers.notes:
Accelerated Healing is an advanced ability that empowers the character to significantly enhance the regenerative capabilities of an ally. By accelerating the body's natural healing processes, this ability ensures that the ally can recover from injuries much faster, maintaining their combat effectiveness even in prolonged battles. The character's intervention allows the hive’s warriors to endure and thrive, even under intense pressure.
When Accelerated Healing is activated, the target's wounds begin to heal at an accelerated rate, visibly knitting together before the eyes of onlookers. A soft, greenish glow suffuses the injured areas, with tiny, sparkling motes of bio-energy swirling around the wounds, mending tissue and restoring vitality with every passing second. The sensation is warm and soothing, as if a gentle wave of energy is washing over the target, steadily erasing the pain and fatigue that once threatened to overwhelm them. The aura of rapid regeneration not only provides physical restoration but also a psychological boost, as the target feels their strength returning with each heartbeat.
With Accelerated Healing, the character ensures that the hive’s warriors remain resilient and capable, able to recover quickly from the rigors of battle and continue fighting with renewed strength.

powers.name: Adaptive Camouflage
powers.effect: If perfectly still: undetectable vs full-spectrum vision. If moving: [Camo Stealth(🏃)] at MR1-3, [Camo Stealth(🏃-1)] at MR5-6, [Camo Stealth(🏃-1)] at MR7-9; fails at MR 10+.
powers.notes:
Adaptive Camouflage is an advanced ability that allows the character to blend seamlessly into any environment, rendering them nearly invisible to the naked eye. This ability is crucial for stealth operations, enabling the character to move undetected through hostile territory and execute ambushes with lethal precision.
When Adaptive Camouflage is activated, the character's suit and exposed skin shift in color and texture to match their surroundings perfectly. As the character moves, their appearance subtly changes to blend with the environment, creating a chameleon-like effect that makes them difficult to detect. In the stillness of the jungle or the urban sprawl, the character becomes a ghost, their outline dissolving into the background as they prepare to strike from the shadows.
Adaptive Camouflage turns the character into an unseen predator, a master of stealth capable of moving through enemy lines undetected and striking with deadly precision.

powers.name: Aether Burst
powers.effect: Melee weapon's Wnds+2
powers.notes:
Aether Burst is a devastating ability that channels the raw power of the character’s Aether Sword, unleashing a concentrated surge of Aetheric energy upon impact. This ability significantly amplifies the damage dealt by the sword, making each strike potentially fatal and leaving a lasting impression on the battlefield.
When Aether Burst is activated, the Aether Sword glows with an intense, otherworldly light, the runes along its blade flaring to life with Aetheric energy. As the character strikes, the sword releases a powerful burst of energy that doubles the severity of the inflicted wounds, causing the enemy to stagger under the force of the blow. The impact is accompanied by a shockwave of light and sound, marking the devastating power of the Aether Burst and ensuring that the strike leaves no doubt of the character’s lethal intent.
Aether Burst transforms the Aether Sword into a weapon of unrivaled destruction, capable of cutting down even the most resilient foes with a single, overpowering strike.

powers.name: Aether Clone
powers.effect: Clone is totally real and can do anything the caster can (powers, weapons, etc.); clone vanishes upon receiving wounds.
powers.notes:
Aether Clone allows the character to summon a temporary duplicate of themselves, formed entirely from Aether energy. This clone is a perfect replica, sharing the same thoughts, motivations, and combat abilities as the original, fighting alongside them to confuse and overwhelm enemies.
As the character channels their energy, a shimmering silhouette begins to form beside them. The outline of the Aether Clone solidifies, taking on the exact appearance of the character, right down to the smallest detail. The clone’s eyes glow with a soft, otherworldly light, its movements perfectly synchronized with the character’s, as if they are one being. To onlookers, the clone appears as a twin, indistinguishable from the original, moving with the same lethal grace and purpose. The air around the clone pulses with residual Aether energy, creating a faint, almost imperceptible haze that betrays its arcane origin.
The Aether Clone stands as a living extension of the character’s will, a mirror image ready to strike fear and confusion into the hearts of their enemies.

powers.name: Aether Leap
powers.effect: [Leap(🏃+2)]; Leave a psionic afterimage [Believe Imgage(👁️)]^👁️.
powers.notes:
Aether Leap is a dynamic ability that allows the character to execute a rapid, long-distance leap, leaving behind a psionic afterimage to disorient and confuse enemies. This ability serves as both a means of quick repositioning and a psychological tactic to mislead opponents.
When Aether Leap is activated, the character seems to blur for a split second before vanishing from their original position. A faint, ghostly image of the character lingers momentarily, shimmering with psionic energy that flickers like a mirage in the heat. The afterimage holds the gaze of enemies, appearing solid and real until it slowly fades into nothingness. Meanwhile, the character reappears in a new location, their sudden materialization accompanied by a subtle, rippling distortion in the air. To onlookers, it seems as if the character has momentarily existed in two places at once, creating a sense of confusion and uncertainty on the battlefield.
Aether Leap transforms the character into an elusive and unpredictable force, leaving enemies grasping at shadows as they strike from an entirely new position.

powers.name: Aether Step
powers.effect: Shuriken [Atk/Dmg(🏃)/(🏃)]; Double normal range; Teleport to target
powers.notes:
Aether Step is a powerful and dynamic ability that allows the character to instantly teleport to an enemy after striking them with an Aether Shuriken. This ability is ideal for swift repositioning and surprise melee attacks, making the character a master of unpredictable and lethal combat.
When Aether Step is activated, the moment the Aether Shuriken hits its target, the character feels a surge of energy as they are instantly teleported adjacent to their enemy. The sudden change in position is disorienting to the foe, leaving them vulnerable to the character’s follow-up melee strike. The character materializes in a blur of motion, their weapon already drawn and poised to deliver a decisive blow before the enemy can react. The range and effectiveness of this teleportation increase with the character’s mastery, allowing them to engage targets from greater distances with this seamless combination of ranged and melee attacks.
Aether Step turns the character into a deadly and elusive force, able to close the gap between themselves and their target in the blink of an eye, delivering fatal strikes with unparalleled speed.

powers.name: Alpha Link
powers.effect: Max 3 allies; pack can mentally talk and allies may choose to use Alpha's Nish instead of their own.
powers.notes:
Alpha Link is a potent telepathic ability that allows the character to establish a mental connection with their allies and, with training, even their foes. This telepathic bond enables the character to communicate thoughts, emotions, and commands instantly, creating a unified consciousness that enhances coordination and understanding among the pack. Through Alpha Link, the character can lead with unmatched precision, ensuring that their allies move as one, responding to threats and opportunities with perfect synchronicity.
When Alpha Link is activated, the character’s eyes glow faintly, signaling the establishment of the mental connection. To the character, the minds of their allies become like beacons of light in the darkness, each one pulsing with its own unique rhythm. Thoughts and emotions flow freely between them, creating a seamless bond that transcends words. For those connected, the world seems to slow down, and a deep sense of unity and purpose takes hold. The character’s presence in their minds is both comforting and commanding, guiding them with silent precision. For foes who become entangled in this link, the experience is disorienting and terrifying, as the character’s thoughts breach their defenses, filling their minds with fear and confusion.
At its height, Alpha Link transforms the character into a true leader, capable of guiding their pack through the most chaotic and dangerous situations with ease. This ability emphasizes the character's role as the alpha, both mentally and physically dominant, leading their allies to victory through sheer force of will and telepathic command.

powers.name: Apparition
powers.effect: Extends caster's hans through a Rift for Atk/Casting/Grabbing or other purposes
powers.notes:
Apparition is a potent ability that allows the character to open a rift directly in front of their chest, linked to another chosen location, forming a bridge between the two. Through this rift, the character can extend their hands and arms, enabling them to perform actions remotely, including wielding weapons, retrieving objects, or interacting with distant allies. The ability to manipulate reality in this manner makes Apparition a versatile and strategic tool in the character’s arsenal.
As the character activates Apparition, a swirling rift of dark energy forms before them, pulsating with a deep, resonant hum. The character’s hands and arms disappear into the rift, only to reappear through another rift at the chosen location, as though space itself has folded to their will. To those witnessing the effect, it appears as if the character is reaching through the very fabric of reality, their limbs emerging from the void to perform precise and calculated actions. The rift’s edges shimmer with a dark light, giving off an eerie, almost hypnotic glow that highlights the character’s control over the dimensions.
Apparition turns the character into a master of spatial manipulation, allowing them to extend their reach beyond physical limitations and perform actions that defy conventional understanding.

powers.name: Assassin's Pool
powers.effect: Converts a failed Assassinate Sniper Atk into a hit if Result+100 would have hit
powers.notes:
Assassin's Pool is a critical resource for the character, designed to ensure the success of their most vital Assassinate Feat attacks. By creating a reserve of points specifically for correcting failed attempts, this ability guarantees that the character's lethal strikes land when they are needed most.
When Assassin's Pool is activated, a cold, focused energy envelops the character as they prepare for a kill. The points generated form a mental reservoir, ready to be tapped into if their initial strike falters. In the heat of battle, this reserve allows the character to adjust their aim or apply extra force, converting what could have been a failure into a deadly, accurate hit. The confidence provided by the Assassin's Pool allows the character to strike with unwavering resolve, knowing that they have the means to ensure their success.
With Assassin's Pool, the character transforms potential failures into decisive victories, making each strike as deadly as it is inevitable.

powers.name: Assassinate
powers.effect: Sniper Shot [Atk/Dmg(👁️+2)/(👁️+3)]; Req: must qualify
powers.notes:
Assassinate is a lethal ability that enables the character to deliver a devastating, first-strike attack with unparalleled precision. Designed for scenarios where surprise and stealth are paramount, this ability ensures that the character can neutralize high-value targets before they even realize they are under threat.
When Assassinate is activated, the world seems to narrow as the character focuses on their target. Time slows, and the character's senses heighten, every detail of the target's movement becoming crystal clear. The character draws their weapon, aiming with deadly intent, and in a single, fluid motion, they strike. The attack is swift, silent, and lethal—two attack rolls and two damage rolls are made, with the character choosing the best outcome from each, ensuring the highest possible damage.
Assassinate turns the character into a silent predator, striking with such precision that their targets are eliminated before they can react.

powers.notes:
This binds another individual to an agreement with the sorcist. This may be a promise, a task, a quest, a secret, etc. The bound individual must willingly accept the binding or it will not work.
If at any time the bound individual breaks the agreement, roll Sk^Best(FR,Resist Sorce). If the roll succeeds, the victim will crumble into dust. There is a maximum number of bound individuals per Sorcist. If the number is exceeded, the sorcist must select one of the previously bound to be freed from the binding. The freed individual will only notice if the sorcist fails a Sk^Int.

powers.name: Bio-Mesh Interface
powers.effect: Direct neural control over bioengineered tools (not weapons): turn on/off, give orders.
powers.notes:
Bio-Mesh Interface is an advanced enhancement to the Bio-Tech Armor, allowing the character to seamlessly integrate and control bioengineered tools and weapons. This interface enables the character to connect neural pathways directly to the armor, allowing them to manipulate their bioengineered arsenal without physical contact. This neural connection streamlines operations, allowing the character to issue complex commands and control multiple devices with just a thought.
When the Bio-Mesh Interface is activated, the armor’s hexagonal plates pulse with a synchronized glow, matching the character’s neural activity. A soft hum emanates from the suit as bio-nanites relay signals between the armor and the character's mind, enabling the autonomous handling of tools and weapons. Tentacle-like appendages move with an almost lifelike grace, adjusting equipment and preparing bio-weapons for use. The sensation for the character is akin to having extra limbs, all perfectly attuned to their thoughts, making the armor feel like an extension of their own body.
At its highest level, Bio-Mesh Interface transforms the Bio-Tech Armor into a versatile and formidable extension of the character’s will, allowing for unparalleled efficiency and precision in combat and support roles.

powers.name: Bio-Weapon
powers.effect: Morphs into bio-blade (slashing), bio-spear (piercing), or bio-club (blunt): [Atk/Dmg(💪+5)/(💪+5)].
powers.notes:
Bio-Weapon is a versatile and formidable ability that enhances the character's Bio-Forge Gauntlet, allowing it to morph into one of three specialized bio-weapons: a bio-blade, a bio-spear, or a bio-club. Each weapon form is tailored for a specific type of damage—slashing, piercing, or blunt—providing the character with the flexibility to adapt to a wide range of combat scenarios. The ability to switch between these forms makes the Bio-Weapon an essential tool in the character’s arsenal, turning the gauntlet into a lethal and adaptable extension of their combat prowess.
When the Bio-Weapon is activated, the Bio-Forge Gauntlet undergoes a rapid transformation, the organic material flowing and reshaping itself with a fluid, almost sentient motion. As the gauntlet morphs, a soft, bioluminescent glow emanates from the surface, illuminating the process. The bio-blade extends into a sleek, razor-sharp edge, designed for swift and precise slashing attacks. The bio-spear elongates into a narrow, pointed form, capable of piercing through the toughest armor with deadly accuracy. The bio-club thickens and hardens, its surface becoming knotted and reinforced, ready to deliver bone-crushing blunt force trauma. Each weapon form pulses with a life-like energy, its surface subtly shifting as though it is alive, and the weapon hums faintly as it prepares for combat.
The Bio-Forge Gauntlet becomes a critical asset, its power and lethality increasing with the character's growing mastery.

powers.name: Blade Barrier
powers.effect: Tight radius AoE [Atk/Dmg(✨)/(✨)] on PC's Nish.
powers.notes:
Blade Barrier allows the character to summon a whirling vortex of ethereal blades that surround and protect them. By hurling a light bladed weapon, the character channels Aether energy to rapidly duplicate the weapon, forming a deadly barrier of spinning blades that shreds any enemy who ventures too close. This barrier serves as both an offensive and defensive measure, turning the character into a mobile fortress of cutting edges.
As the character initiates the Blade Barrier, the thrown weapon begins to multiply mid-air, each duplicate shimmering with Aetheric light. The blades encircle the character in a tight, spinning formation, creating a vortex of steel and energy that moves with them. The air within the barrier vibrates with the sound of slicing metal, and the surrounding area becomes a deadly zone where the faintest movement triggers a flurry of slashing attacks. To onlookers, the character appears as a silhouette encased in a cyclone of lethal blades, their every movement accompanied by a symphony of sharp, metallic whispers.
Blade Barrier transforms the character into an impenetrable force of destruction, where any enemy daring enough to approach is met with a storm of slicing death.

powers.notes: This powerful attack creates a fist-shaped mass of kinetic energy approximately 18" across, which then strikes a target or location in range. Causing full damage to the target (if hit) and Half damage to all targets within 1r. Regular explosion avoidance rules apply to those in 1r. If the primary target was missed, they must still use the explosion rules to avoid the Half damage potential. If the primary target is hit no explosion avoidance may be made.

powers.name: Blazing Trail
powers.effect: narrow, waist-high flame trail (max short length) dealing flame [Atk/Dmg(✨)/(✨)].
powers.notes:
Blazing Trail is a devastating ability that allows the character to weaponize their movements, leaving a searing path of fire in their wake. As the character moves across the battlefield, the ground beneath them ignites, creating a wall of flames that scorches any enemies who dare to follow. This fiery trail not only inflicts significant damage equivalent to a Flame Lance but also serves as a strategic tool, creating barriers that hinder enemy movement and protect allies.
Visually, Blazing Trail transforms the battlefield into a blazing inferno, with the character at its epicenter. As they dash forward, the ground erupts in flames, leaving behind a trail of flickering, crackling fire that grows in intensity with every step. The heat distorts the air, and the flames roar as they consume everything in their path, creating an impenetrable barrier of fire that forces enemies to think twice before pursuing. The sight of the character surrounded by this fiery trail is a fearsome display of raw power, as they turn even their retreat into a deadly offensive maneuver.
With Blazing Trail, the character becomes a relentless force, turning even a retreat into a devastating offensive maneuver that leaves a path of destruction in their wake.

powers.name: Blood Frenzy
powers.effect: MR(+2), 2 melee Atks per Rnd, [Atk/Dmg(💪-1)/(💪+1)]; To [Break Frenzy(👁️)]^(50-5 per round) or continue Frenzy.
powers.notes:
Blood Frenzy unleashes the primal fury of the character, pushing them into a berserk state where their attack speed and power are dramatically heightened. This ability embodies the raw, unrelenting aggression that defines the character, transforming them into a whirlwind of violence that relentlessly targets any enemy—or ally—within reach.
As Blood Frenzy takes hold, the character's physical appearance becomes wild and fearsome. Their muscles swell, veins bulging beneath their skin as their eyes take on a feral, blood-red hue. A guttural snarl escapes their lips, and the air around them seems to crackle with violent energy. The character's movements are frenetic and chaotic, each swing of their weapon or claw leaving a blur of motion in its wake. To those watching, it is as though the character has become a living storm, their every strike fueled by a deep, primal rage that knows no bounds.
At the height of Blood Frenzy, the character is a terrifying sight, a force of nature that cannot be stopped or reasoned . Their unrelenting fury ensures that they will continue to fight until every enemy is vanquished, their savage power turning the tide of battle with sheer, overwhelming aggression.

powers.name: Blood Pact
powers.effect: As target recieves Wnds -> Caster Blinks to target, auto-hit bite no Dmg;  [Blood Link(✨)]^✨ -> All target's wounds halved, Caster takes 1 2nd Deg Wnd each time; Willing targets may skip save.
powers.notes:
Blood Pact is a powerful and sinister ability that allows the character to blink to a target within range just as they receive damage or some other ill effect and bite them, creating a supernatural link that shares the effect between the two. This ability is typically used to protect an ally by sharing their wounds or ill effects, but it can also be used on a foe to save them for questioning or some other desired outcome. The character’s bite creates a temporary bond that allows them to endure part of the damage or effect, lessening the impact on the target while sustaining their own vitality.
When the character activates Blood Pact, they disappear in a blur of speed, reappearing next to their chosen target just as the damage or effect takes hold. Their bite is quick and precise, drawing just enough blood to establish the bond without causing significant harm. As the bond forms, a dark energy flows between the character and their target, sharing the pain or effect, and allowing the character to mitigate the worst of it. This ability is both a protective measure and a tactical tool, allowing the character to control the flow of battle by deciding who bears the brunt of the damage.
Blood Pact highlights the character’s predatory instincts, allowing them to manipulate the battlefield by deciding who suffers and who survives. This ability ensures that the character can protect their allies or manipulate their enemies, turning the tide of battle in their favor with a single, well-timed bite.

powers.name: Blood Strike
powers.effect: Each Blade hit on same target: [Atk/Dmg(💪)/(💪)] causes +5 cummulative Wnd bonus and regenerate caster 1st Deg wound by # of hits (i.e. 1, 2, 3...)
powers.notes:
Blood Strike is a formidable ability that transforms the character’s Bloodblade into a weapon of deadly efficiency and regenerative power. With each swing of the blade, the character taps into the lifeblood of their enemies, drawing strength and vitality from every successful strike. As the blade bites into flesh, it not only inflicts severe wounds but also channels a portion of the stolen life force back into the character, healing their own injuries. Each successive hit on the same target increases the character’s precision and power, making the Bloodblade a terrifying instrument of sustained combat.
The visual manifestation of Blood Strike is both mesmerizing and chilling. As the Bloodblade makes contact, the area around the wound glows with a deep crimson light, pulsing rhythmically with the beat of the target's heart. The blood drawn from the wound seems to defy gravity, flowing along the blade's edge and into the character’s body, where it visibly rejuvenates them. With each consecutive strike, the blade's glow intensifies, and the character’s movements become more fluid and deadly, as if they are feeding off the very life essence of their foe.
Blood Strike embodies the relentless nature of the character, turning every encounter into a battle for survival where the character grows stronger as their enemy weakens. The ability to channel their own vitality into their strikes adds a dark twist, allowing the character to inflict even greater harm at the cost of their own life force. In the hands of a skilled character, Blood Strike ensures that the longer the fight drags on, the more unstoppable they become.

powers.name: Bloodbond
powers.effect: Caster must have caused bite Dmg: Any new target wounds regenerate cast for 1/2 value
powers.notes:
Bloodbond is a dark and parasitic ability that allows the character to establish a supernatural link with an enemy through a bite, drawing life force directly from their wounds. Once a target is marked by the Bloodbond, the character siphons vitality from any damage inflicted upon the marked foe, regenerating their own wounds in the process. This ability creates a symbiotic relationship where the more harm the enemy suffers, the stronger and more resilient the character becomes. The bond is both a tactical tool and a survival mechanism, allowing the character to recover from injuries that would otherwise be crippling, making them a relentless adversary in battle.
The moment the Bloodbond is established, the character’s eyes gleam with a predatory light as they sink their fangs into their prey. A faint, eerie connection forms between the character and the target, visible only to those attuned to the dark arts, as a thin, glowing thread of energy links them. As the battle rages on and the target is wounded, the character’s wounds begin to close, their vitality restored with every drop of blood spilled. The more the target suffers, the more powerful the character becomes, feeding off their enemy’s pain to fuel their own survival.
Bloodbond is the embodiment of the character’s predatory nature, allowing them to turn their enemies’ strength against them. This ability ensures that as long as the character can maintain the bond, they remain a formidable force on the battlefield, growing stronger and more resilient with each passing moment.

powers.name: Displace
powers.effect: Vanish and reappear: distance [=(✨)] sq; no intervening movement. If held: [Displace(✨)]^Dif then roll distance.
powers.notes:
*Displace* causes its user to vanish and reappear some distance away. The sorcist may select the direction and distance of the displacement up to a maximum number rolled. The sorcist does not move over the intervening distance, but simply disappears from one spot then appears in the other. If the sorcist is being held (such as MA Hold, Tangler Grenade, etc.) a Sk^ must succeed, then a second roll is made for actual distance traveled.
Displacing through walls or into areas which the sorcist can’t view is dangerous as the sorcist may end up displaced into a solid object. If this occurs refer to *RB, hazards*.

powers.name: Displace Group
powers.effect: Willing targets (including caster) vanish and reappear at chosen square within [=(✨)] sq. Group arrives adjacent; facing unchanged.
powers.notes:
*Displace Group* causes a number of willing targets to vanish and reappear some distance away. Targets must be willing and may including the sorcist. The sorcist may select a destination square within the maximum rolled distance (measured from the sorcist, not any of the targets). The targets will then arrive in adjacent squares “roughly” in the same direction from the center as they started when considered as a whole. Their facing will be unchanged. If the sorcist was also a target, then they will appear in the central target square. Once the destination square is selected, the player can move the figures, but the GM will make any final adjustments as desired.
The group does not move over the intervening distances, but simply disappears from one spot then appears in the other. If any member of the group is being held (such as MA Hold, Tangler Grenade, etc.) a separate Sk^ must succeed, or that target is not displaced along with the others.
Displacing through walls or into areas which the sorcist can’t view is challenging, but not dangerous. If the ability ends up displacing targets into a solid objects, they will simply be left behind. This does not apply to the Sorcist themself and if displaced into a solid object, consult the *RB, hazards*. A larger group is more difficult due to the clustering around a central square requiring a larger open space free of obstacles.

This ability is perfect for delivering cryptic warnings, issuing commands, or conversing in a way that underscores the character's otherworldly nature. The sound of their voice is a chilling blend of multiple tones, creating an unsettling echo that lingers in the air and strikes fear into the hearts of those who hear it.

The words they speak resonate directly in the ears of their chosen recipients, bypassing walls, doors, and even the vacuum of space. The recipients hear the voice as if it character right next to them, a spectral whisper that is impossible to ignore. The tone is unsettling, a chorus of overlapping voices that seem to come from all directions at once, creating a disorienting and unnerving experience. To anyone else, the words are incomprehensible, lost in the echoes of the void, but to the intended recipients, the message is clear and impossible to forget.
Echoing Whispers allows the character to communicate with an eerie, otherworldly presence, ensuring that their words are heard and remembered by those they choose to speak to, no matter the distance or obstacles in their way.

powers.name: Eclipse

powers.notes:
Eclipse is a formidable ability that allows the character to summon a globe of impenetrable darkness, engulfing a designated area in shadow. This ability not only disorients and blinds enemies but also amplifies the character’s powers, particularly those related to the Void Weaver or Wraith Form, making them an even more formidable force within the darkness. Eclipse turns the battlefield into a domain of shadow, where the character reigns supreme.
As Eclipse is summoned, the light within the designated area seems to collapse inward, as if drawn into a singularity. A dense, swirling globe of darkness envelops the area, with the shadows inside shifting and writhing like a living entity. Within this globe, the character is the only being capable of seeing through the shadows, their vision slightly dimmed but otherwise unhindered. To those caught within the Eclipse, the world becomes a void of pitch-black nothingness, where even the faintest glimmer of light is snuffed out. The air within the globe feels colder, heavier, as if the darkness itself is pressing down on all within it, amplifying the character’s connection to the void.
Eclipse transforms the battlefield into a realm of pure darkness, where the character’s powers are heightened, and their enemies are left to stumble blindly through a world they no longer control.

Enemies within the veil find their vision impaired and their nerves frayed, making them more vulnerable to the character’s attacks. Every wound inflicted by the character within the veil forces their enemies to confront their deepest fears, leaving them paralyzed or fleeing in terror. This ability can be cast while in certain Dark Forms, allowing the character to fully capitalize on the veil’s effects while maintaining their monstrous presence.
Eclipse Veil turns the battlefield into the character’s domain, where they can control the flow of combat with fear and darkness. This ability ensures that the character remains a deadly and elusive predator, striking from the shadows and leaving their enemies in a state of constant dread.

As Elemental Str Surge takes effect, the character’s physique swells with newfound power, their muscles bulging and their veins pulsing with energy. Their every movement is charged with explosive strength, and their blows land with bone-crushing force. The ground trembles under their feet as they charge into battle, their enemies scattering before them. This surge of power is a sight to behold, as the character unleashes their full might, turning the tide of battle with sheer physical dominance.
Elemental Str Surge is a critical tool for the character, providing them with the strength to overcome any obstacle and the power to dominate their enemies in close-quarters combat. This ability ensures that when the character needs to rely on brute force, they can do so with devastating effect.

When fired, the spore pod releases a burst of entangling spores that rapidly spread upon impact, creating a dense web of bio-organic fibers that ensnare and immobilize enemies. Upon activation, Entangling Burst fires a pod that explodes into a cloud of fine, shimmering spores, which then coalesce into thick, fibrous strands. These fibers rapidly grow and intertwine, forming a web-like structure that clings to everything within the area of effect. The fibers emit a faint, greenish glow, making them visible in the dimmest of lights, and their sticky, resilient texture makes it difficult for anyone trapped within to break free. The fibers are resistant to most conventional weapons, requiring powerful slashing or chopping blows to sever them.
Entangling Burst is an essential ability for any character seeking to dominate the flow of combat, turning the environment into a web of ensnarement that leaves enemies at the mercy of the hive.

Entangling Shot is a powerful and strategic ability that enhances the character’s Living Bow, transforming a simple arrow into a formidable tool of battlefield control. Upon impact, the arrow rapidly sprouts into a massive, self-repairing vine cage that entangles and immobilizes its target, making it nearly impossible for them to escape.
When the Entangling Shot strikes its target, the arrowhead bursts open with a flourish of rapid growth, unleashing thick, sinewy vines that coil tightly around the victim. The vines are a deep green, dotted with small thorns, and they writhe and twist as they form an impenetrable cage. The vines continuously regenerate, healing any damage taken almost instantly, making escape nearly impossible without extraordinary strength. The cage pulses with life, tightening its grip with each passing moment, leaving the trapped target helpless and at the mercy of the character.
Entangling Shot turns the tide of battle by rendering key enemies helpless, leaving them vulnerable to follow-up attacks or capture.

powers.name: Ghost Walk

powers.notes:
Sorcists use this power to become completely insubstantial. A *ghost walking* sorcist grows dim and transparent, actually occupying another dimension. The sorcist may then walk through nearly anything (walls, doors, other living things, etc.)
*Ghost walkers* are only affected by (and can only be affected by) others in the *ghost* dimension. Vision is the only sense that “can” (see Versions) occur between the dimensions, but at best things in the other dimension look faint and hazy. Objects carried by the sorcist also join the Sorcist in the ghost dimension, and remain that way until the sorcist returns to this dimension. If reappear in a solid object, the Sorcist will be slid to the closest open square as per GM.
*Ghost walkers* must remain within a Teachered area as rolled. The tether is the square upon which Ghost Walk was initially cast. Going beyond this tether limit instantly causes the Sorcist to become solid again and the ability ends. Each round the Sorcits may walk in the Ghost dimension using their normal MR (until Ver5). Also there is NO known way to communicate between the dimensions.

powers.notes:
Gravitational Wells is a tactical ability that allows the character to manipulate gravity within specific areas, creating zones that immobilize or severely hinder the movement of enemies. These gravity-altering fields make it nearly impossible for foes to maneuver, trapping them and leaving them vulnerable to the character’s attacks. The affected area is marked by a conspicuous glyph, warning those who are perceptive enough to recognize the danger.
When Gravitational Wells is cast, the ground within the targeted area darkens, and a large, glowing glyph appears at its center, pulsating with an eerie, gravitational force. The air within the zone feels heavy, as if the very atmosphere is pressing down on everything within. Enemies caught in the field struggle against the overwhelming pull, their movements slowed to a crawl, while those who fail to escape are dragged to the ground, pinned by the crushing weight of intensified gravity. The visual distortion within the zone, as if the air itself is bending, serves as a constant reminder of the unseen force at work, making the area a deadly trap for any who dare to enter.
Gravitational Wells allows the character to dominate the battlefield, turning areas into inescapable traps that crush the will and bodies of their enemies.

powers.name: Gravity Warp

powers.name: Growth Hormone
powers.effect: Target grows [=(✨)] inches; melee, Might, AR all at Adv
powers.notes:
Growth Hormone is a specialized ability used by the character to trigger rapid and dramatic increases in an ally’s size and strength. By administering a powerful stim, the character activates the target’s genetic potential, causing their body to expand in size and their muscles to grow exponentially. This transformation turns the ally into a towering force of destruction, capable of dealing devastating damage and withstanding significant attacks.
As the Growth Hormone stim is injected, the target's body begins to swell, their muscles rippling and expanding with each passing moment. The transformation is accompanied by a deep, resonant hum as the target's physiology adapts to the sudden influx of power. Their skin stretches taut over bulging muscles, and their voice may deepen as their vocal cords adjust to their new size. The air around them seems to thrum with energy, creating a palpable sense of awe and intimidation. The enhanced size not only boosts their physical capabilities but also casts a looming shadow over the battlefield, intimidating foes and rallying allies.
With Growth Hormone, the character can drastically alter the dynamics of a battle, empowering their allies to crush opposition with overwhelming might. This ability is a testament to the character's mastery of bioengineering, enabling them to enhance the hive's warriors to unprecedented levels of power.

powers.name: Hallucination
powers.effect: All minds in range see false images: [Hallucination(✨)]^Dif (WP+Adj). Persists while concentrating; targets may [Awareness(👁️)]^Dif each rnd to break.
powers.notes:
Using this enhancement, the psionicist causes all minds within range to see things that are not really there at Sk^. the is a combination of the target’s WP+Adj.
The images created must be described to the GM, who then determines. If the change is easy to believe or expected, like having an item appear where it should be even if it isn’t there, then the Adj may reduce the to near zero. If the image is of a familiar person walking into the room, then the will be a little higher due to the complexity of the hallucination. If the hallucination is an unexpected and complex, entirely fake scene like a group in a bar bar suddenly being on a space ship as it crashes, then the may be extremely high.
The Hallucination will persist as long as the Psionicist concentrates at the Act cost below. Targets may attempt to break the hallucination every round unless the GM determines that there is no reason (such as a simple, easy to believe hallucination or a really great roll by the player).

powers.notes:
*Haze* creates an eerie, psychic fog in the mind of a victim at Sk^WP. Victims are unable to see or think clearly — the victim suffers a penalty on all mind effecting rolls/stats. for the duration of the haze.
The haze exists only in the victim’s mind, and is not visible to others.

powers.name: Healing Grove
powers.effect: 3×3 sq grove; Allies in grove regenerate [2d4] 1st Deg wounds per round.
powers.notes:
Healing Grove is a powerful restorative ability that allows the character to create a sacred area filled with life-giving flora, providing continuous healing to allies within its boundaries. This grove taps into the natural regenerative properties of plants, enhanced by the character's biotechnological mastery, to create a sanctuary of renewal on the battlefield. Allies who enter the Healing Grove are enveloped in a soothing, rejuvenating aura that accelerates their healing, mending wounds and restoring vitality.
The Healing Grove manifests as a lush, vibrant area where the ground is carpeted with soft moss and delicate flowers that emit a warm, golden light. The air within the grove is thick with the scent of wild herbs and fresh rain, creating a serene atmosphere that instantly soothes and refreshes those who step within its bounds. As the battle rages on outside, the grove remains a tranquil oasis, with each breath of the character further amplifying the healing energies that flow through the flora, knitting flesh and replenishing strength.
In the heart of battle, the Healing Grove serves as a vital sanctuary, ensuring that the character’s allies can endure and prevail, their wounds closing as fast as they are inflicted, making the grove a symbol of hope and resilience.

powers.name: Healing Hymn
powers.effect: Restore d✨ Vit❤️ to an ally

powers.name: Healing Light
powers.effect: Restore d✨ Vit❤️ to ally

powers.name: Healing Light (Greater)
powers.effect: Heal 1d4+1 Vit❤️

powers.name: Healing Touch
powers.effect: [Heal 1st Deg(✨-1)],  [Heal 2nd Deg(✨-1)], [Heal 3rd Deg(✨-2)], or [Cure(✨+2)] Poison or Disease
powers.notes:
Healing Touch is a profound and versatile ability that allows the character to mend injuries and cure ailments through a blend of natural and biotechnological methods. When the ability is activated, the character’s hands emit a soft green aura, and tendrils of bioluminescent energy gently envelop the wounded area. These living energies work to knit flesh, purge toxins, and restore vitality, offering a highly effective and visually captivating healing process that reflects the character’s deep connection to nature and their advanced bioengineering skills.
As the character’s hands move over the afflicted area, the tendrils of light penetrate the skin, creating a warm sensation that soothes pain and accelerates the body’s natural healing processes. The aura pulses in time with the character’s heartbeat, each pulse closing wounds and revitalizing the patient. The surrounding area seems to come alive with the scent of fresh earth and the distant sound of rustling leaves, as if nature itself is lending its strength to the character’s efforts.
Healing Touch is not just a remedy for injuries; it is a manifestation of the character’s role as a healer and protector, using the gifts of nature to bring life and health to those in need, even in the direst of circumstances.

powers.name: Hearing Boost
powers.effect: Enhance hearing: Awareness (hearing) at bonus [=(👁️-1)] or similar. Cannot stack with Super Hearing.
powers.notes:
This discipline makes the psychosomaticist’s skin more sensitive to vibrations in the air, greatly enhancing hearing.
*Hearing boost* allows the psychosomaticist to make his or her hearing-based Awa roll at a bonus.

powers.name: Heat Wave
powers.effect: short distance long wave, travels short to medium range; [Heat(✨)]^🫀 or [Dmg(✨)]
powers.notes:
Heat Wave is a formidable ability that allows the character to unleash a wave of intense heat, designed to disorient and weaken all those caught in its path. When activated, the character projects a searing wave that starts just beyond their position, rapidly rolling forward like a deadly ocean wave. This wave of heat affects both foes and allies indiscriminately, forcing all within its reach to save against their fortitude or suffer the debilitating effects of heat stroke.
As the Heat Wave surges forward, the air itself seems to ripple and shimmer with the intensity of the heat. The ground scorches as the wave passes over it, leaving behind a faint trail of steam and burnt earth. Those caught in the wave feel an immediate blast of oppressive heat, sapping their strength and leaving them dazed and disoriented. The wave moves with a relentless, rolling force, spreading across the battlefield and affecting everything in its path with the crushing power of intense, concentrated heat.
Heat Wave is a strategic tool of battlefield control, enabling the character to sap the strength of their enemies, turning the tide of battle in their favor with relentless heat.

powers.name: Herbal Poultice

powers.name: Herbal Tincture
powers.effect: Makes 1 tincture (max of 1 unused in existence); tincture regenerate [1d10] 1st Deg wounds AND [Sk(✨+1)] to cure disease or poison.
powers.notes:
Herbal Tincture is a versatile and restorative ability of the character, enabling them to harness the healing properties of plants to create powerful tinctures. These tinctures, carefully crafted by the character using summoned or found flora, provide a range of benefits that can be stored for future use. Each tincture is a small, leaf-wrapped or gourd-contained remedy that, when consumed, delivers a potent effect chosen by the imbiber at the time of drinking.
The process of creating a tincture is an art in itself. The resulting tincture glows faintly with a natural green light, the aroma of fresh-cut leaves wafting from its container. When consumed, the tincture spreads warmth through the body, either knitting wounds, neutralizing poisons, or purging diseases, depending on the need of the moment.
Herbal Tincture exemplifies the character’s ability to prepare for any eventuality, ensuring that nature’s remedies are always at hand to sustain their allies through the trials of battle.

powers.name: Hero’s Blessing

powers.name: Hide in Plain Sight
powers.effect: If still; Stealth with Advantage until you act

powers.name: Hide in Shadows
powers.effect: MR(3). Take 20 Wnds immediately and each round (on Nish) if not in shadows or when crossing between shadows.
powers.notes:
Hide in Shadows is a powerful and risky ability that allows the character to detach from their physical form, becoming a pure shadow wraith capable of moving undetected and nearly impervious to damage. In this form, the character is free to move through interconnected shadows, slipping through the smallest of cracks and evading detection with ease. However, the character must remain in shadows to maintain this form, as exposure to light or the loss of shadows forces them to return to their abandoned armor, suffering severe wounds in the process.
As the character invokes Hide in Shadows, their physical body seems to melt away, leaving behind a dark, shapeless form that merges seamlessly with the surrounding shadows. In this state, the character becomes a living shadow, indistinguishable from the darkness around them. They move with a fluid grace, slipping through cracks and crevices that would be impossible for a physical being to traverse. The shadow form is silent and nearly invisible, a formless wraith that passes through the world without leaving a trace. However, this form is fragile, and the character knows that they must avoid light and remain within the safety of the shadows, for if the shadows are banished, they will be forced to return to their physical form, vulnerable and wounded.
Hide in Shadows transforms the character into a true creature of the night, a being of pure darkness that can move unseen and untouched, but at the risk of great harm if they are exposed to the light.

powers.name: Hive Link Swarm
powers.effect: Swarm 10r; unsealed allies in AoE share all active thoughts and vision.
powers.notes:
Hive Link Swarm is a powerful ability utilized by the character to enhance battlefield coordination and communication among allies. By constructing and releasing a cloud of flying mites, the character establishes a telepathic connection within the swarm’s area of effect, allowing all unsealed allies to share their active thoughts seamlessly. This telepathic link ensures that the hive operates with unmatched precision, enabling rapid strategic planning, instant information sharing, and perfectly synchronized movements.
When Hive Link Swarm is activated, the air around the character buzzes with the faint sound of tiny wings as the swarm of bio-mites takes flight. The mites form a shimmering cloud that pulses with a soft, greenish light, moving in tandem with the character as they traverse the battlefield. Allies within the swarm’s radius feel a sudden clarity of thought as their minds are linked, allowing them to communicate wordlessly and share their sensory experiences. The sensation is both comforting and empowering, as each ally becomes acutely aware of their surroundings and the thoughts of their comrades. As the swarm expands, the shared information grows richer, including not only thoughts but also smells, touches, and even visual data, creating a deeply integrated hive mind.
Hive Link Swarm transforms the character and their allies into a perfectly synchronized unit, capable of overwhelming any adversary with their unity and precision.

powers.name: Holo-Cloak
powers.effect: Invisible (visible light only); silenced. [Stealth(🏃+1)]^👁️ only if opponent actively scanning or has hidden/special vision.
powers.notes:
The Holo-Cloak is a personal cloaking device that renders the character invisible to most sensors and visual detection. This high-tech device bends light and electronic signals around the character, creating the illusion of empty space where they stand, making it a powerful tool for stealth and infiltration missions.
When the Holo-Cloak is activated, a shimmering field of energy envelops the character, distorting the light and making them appear to dissolve into thin air. As the character moves, the cloak adjusts, maintaining their invisibility and silencing any sounds they make. The faint distortion left behind is nearly impossible to detect unless someone is actively searching for it, allowing the character to move undetected through even the most heavily guarded areas.
With the Holo-Cloak, the character becomes a shadow, unseen and unheard, capable of infiltrating enemy territory and completing their mission with perfect stealth.

powers.name: Holo-Clone
powers.effect: Projects 1 AI holo-duplicate, [Looks Real(👁️)]^👁️ for those who try to determine real caster.
powers.notes:
Holo-Clone is a sophisticated ability that enhances the character's Spectre Armor, enabling them to create lifelike holographic duplicates of themselves. These holo-clones are indistinguishable from the character in appearance and behavior, making them a powerful tool for misdirection and confusion on the battlefield.
When activated, the Spectre Armor shimmers briefly before multiple holographic replicas of the character appear around them. These clones move in perfect synchronization with the character, their every step and gesture mirroring the original with uncanny accuracy. To the enemy, it’s impossible to discern which figure is real as the holo-clones dart and weave, creating a chaotic dance of light and motion that confounds even the sharpest eyes.
With Holo-Clone, the character turns deception into a deadly art, leaving their enemies disoriented and vulnerable as they strike from the shadows.

powers.notes: This enhancement lets the psionicist throw hurled weapons with the force of their mind. Both the weapon and target must be within range. Any hurled weapon may be used, but if it is an improvised weapon, it must be VERY ideal and GM approved. This ability is a favorite with Shirrac users who can keep one or more shirracs active at all times. The ability’s long range is of note as well as the ability to attack multiple targets if desired. If the target weapon is being held by another, hurl will not work (but Jerk may be of great use here). However, if a weapon is loosely carried by another (e.g., dagger in a non-clasped sheath) then the weapon may be targeted.

powers.notes:
The user becomes rigid and bonds to any contacted surface. This allows sorcists, and the surface immediately beneath their feet, to become fused and bound by an infusing sorce energy that makes them extremely difficult to move (very enhanced Str versus any attempt). The sorcist and surface are also extremely hard to damage (see AR bonus \- note this is not AR+\# but actual,+\#). The same bonus applies to any save or other stat that being infused as a sorce statue would create such as resistance to explosion, heat, cold, etc. But not resistant to mind effects, poison (should the damage actually get through the impressive armor), etc.
Even if the surface is torn away or destroyed, the sorcist will remain standing on a small fragment of the surface, possibly floating in midair if the ground beneath was destroyed.

powers.name: Incendiary Barrage
powers.effect: 3×3 area [Atk/Dmg(✨)/(✨)] for Dur rnds; only harms flammable targets.
powers.notes:
Incendiary Barrage is a devastating ability that allows the character to unleash a relentless salvo of fiery projectiles over a wide area, engulfing multiple enemies in flames. When activated, the character rapidly fires a series of incendiary rounds that cover the designated area, igniting anything flammable in their path. This ability is particularly lethal to those made of or carrying flammable materials, including most living creatures, organic matter, and unprotected objects.
Visually, the Incendiary Barrage is a spectacle of raw firepower. The character launches a barrage of fiery projectiles that streak through the air like shooting stars, leaving glowing trails in their wake. Upon impact, each projectile explodes in a burst of flame, sending out fiery tendrils that latch onto anything flammable. The targeted area is quickly engulfed in an inferno, with flames spreading rapidly and consuming everything within reach. The battlefield becomes a sea of fire, with the character at the center of the destruction.
Incendiary Barrage epitomizes raw, uncontained firepower, transforming the character into a relentless force of fiery destruction that incinerates everything in its path.

powers.name: Increased Stamina
powers.effect: Target's: Moxie Atr and Skills gain *1.5; Abosbs 5 Wnds per hit
powers.notes:
Increased Stamina is an advanced bioengineering ability that allows the character to modify an ally's metabolic processes, greatly enhancing their stamina and endurance. This ability optimizes the body's energy production and utilization, ensuring that the ally can sustain peak performance for extended periods without succumbing to fatigue, making them a more formidable presence in prolonged engagements.
When Increased Stamina is activated, the target experiences a surge of vitality coursing through their body. Their breathing steadies, and their heart rate becomes more efficient, as if their entire system is being fine-tuned for endurance. A subtle, invigorating warmth spreads from their core, revitalizing their muscles and clearing their mind of exhaustion. The target feels lighter, more agile, and filled with an unshakable resolve to press on. The sensation is akin to catching a second wind, where every step feels easier and every movement more controlled, allowing them to fight longer and harder without wearing down.
Increased Stamina is an essential tool for the character, ensuring that the hive's warriors can outlast their enemies and maintain their dominance on the battlefield. By enhancing the ally’s ability to endure, the character ensures that the hive remains a resilient and unstoppable force.

powers.name: Inferno Blow
powers.effect: [Atk/Dmg(💪)/(💪+1)] on main target, up to two adjacent targets [Atk/Dmg(💪+2)/(💪-1)]
powers.notes:
Inferno Blow is a devastating ability that enhances the character's Inferno Blade, allowing it to unleash a searing heatwave with every strike. Upon activation, this ability channels the flames of the blade into a powerful blow, causing an intense heatwave to radiate outward from the point of impact. Nearby enemies with defenses and armor ratings equal to or lesser than the initial target are scorched by this overwhelming heat, suffering additional damage. This makes the Inferno Blade not just a weapon of singular focus but a tool for area-wide destruction, spreading its fiery wrath across the battlefield.
When Inferno Blow is unleashed, the heatwave is visually stunning and terrifying. Flames erupt from the point of impact, sending shockwaves of heat in all directions. Enemies caught within range are momentarily engulfed in flames, their armor glowing red-hot as the heatwave sears through their defenses. This intense display of power transforms the battlefield into a smoldering inferno, leaving a trail of scorched earth and shattered foes in its wake.
With each swing, Inferno Blow turns the battlefield into a blazing crucible, where only the strongest can hope to survive.

powers.name: Insect Swarm
powers.effect: Small Radius swarm MR 2. In/entering swarm on caster's Nish: [Sk(✨)]^🫀 or suffer [Sk(✨-1)] Wnds
powers.notes:
Insect Swarm is a fearsome ability that enhances the character’s Botanic Grenades, unleashing a deadly cloud of poisonous, biting insects upon the battlefield. These insects are relentless in their attack, capable of penetrating all but the most airtight armor, and they inflict severe damage on any living being caught within their swarm.
When the Insect Swarm is unleashed, the air around the battlefield becomes thick with the buzzing, whirring sound of countless tiny wings. The insects pour forth from the Botanic Grenade in a dark, seething cloud, moving as one with a terrifying, predatory instinct. The swarm engulfs its target, with the insects biting and stinging relentlessly, injecting venom that causes excruciating pain and rapid deterioration. The swarm moves like a living, breathing entity, flowing across the battlefield and leaving devastation in its wake as it seeks out new victims to consume.
Insect Swarm turns the battlefield into a living nightmare, ensuring that the character’s enemies are overwhelmed by the relentless onslaught of nature’s fury.

powers.notes:
Integrated Targeting is a high-tech enhancement for the character's Silenced Plasma Pistol, providing seamless integration with the character's visor or neural implant for precise and coordinated attacks. This system allows the character to maximize their offensive potential by targeting multiple enemies with unparalleled accuracy.
When Integrated Targeting is activated, the character's visor lights up with tactical data, highlighting marked and locked targets across the battlefield. The pistol’s targeting system synchronizes with the character’s neural interface, allowing them to either unleash a barrage of shots on all identified threats simultaneously or focus on marking additional targets for future strikes. As the character pulls the trigger, the pistol fires with lightning speed, each shot perfectly aligned with the data fed through the visor, ensuring that no opportunity is wasted.
With Integrated Targeting, the character becomes a master of precision warfare, capable of turning the tide of battle through calculated and coordinated strikes.

Although you can Jerk a small opponent, this ability is most often used to disarm opponents or remove an item from some location.

powers.notes:
Landing creates a cushion of mental force which will slow a fall and absorb damage. This may be used to affect the indicated number of targets in range (including the psionicist).
The psionicist must make a *skill* roll to reduce the target’s falling distance (in feet) by the amount rolled. If there is any falling damage left, the normal falling rules still apply (i.e., an AR check is still allowed).
If the ONLY target is the Psionicist, then the action cost is always Act(\~).

powers.name: Levitate Other
powers.effect: Disk lifts target vertically; [Levitate(✨)]^🏃 to resist. Target may hop off; move disk at MR each rnd.
powers.notes:
This creates a disk of psionic energy which can lift targets vertically (up or down). The disk may not move horizontally. The disk lasts as long as the user maintains concentration.
If used against an enemy Sk^Def or the target simply hops off. At any later time the victim may, of course, jump off, but would suffer normal falling damage. This ability is often used to raise or lower allies or lift opponents into the air and drop them. Note, opponents suffer no significant penalty to stats such as Def, or Atks as long as they remain in range.
Range: The ability’s listed range is the start range of the target. Once levitate starts, the disks can be lifted/lowered beyond the casting range.

powers.name: Levitate Self
powers.effect: Psionic disk under user: vertical (and slight horizontal) movement. Attacks from below: +AR from disk.
powers.notes: This power creates a psionic disk beneath the user, which may lift the psionicist and anything carried vertically (up or down) as well as a slight horizontal drift. Unlike Levitate Other, Levitate Self’s energy disk is also battle hardened such that attacks from below gain an AR bonus due to the psionic disk acting as a shield.

powers.name: Life Drain
powers.effect: Tight radius AoE: [Life Drain(✨)]^✨ → 5 Wnd/rnd cummulative. Per target wounded per round, caster regenerates 1 1st Deg wound.
powers.notes:
Life Drain is a potent and terrifying ability that allows the character to siphon the life force from all living beings within its area of effect. Upon activation, the character radiates a dark, ethereal mist that subtly draws out the vitality of nearby creatures, friend and foe alike. This draining aura inflicts wounds each round, steadily weakening those within its radius. As their life force ebbs away, victims experience growing fatigue and injury, leaving them more vulnerable to the character’s further assaults.
The dark mist that envelops the battlefield when Life Drain is activated is almost imperceptible at first, but its effects are quickly felt by those within its reach. The character stands at the center of this malevolent aura, drawing strength from the life energy of those around them. Each round, the wounds inflicted by Life Drain sap the vitality of its victims, weakening them while simultaneously healing the character. For every five wounds caused by Life Drain, the character regenerates one of their own wounds, making them increasingly difficult to defeat as the battle wears on.
Life Drain exemplifies the character’s predatory nature, allowing them to feed on the life force of their enemies while sustaining themselves in prolonged battles. This ability ensures that the character remains a formidable opponent, capable of turning the tide of battle through sheer endurance and the relentless draining of their enemies’ vitality.

powers.name: Lupine Agility

powers.notes:
Lupine Agility grants the character unparalleled acrobatic prowess, enhancing their reflexes, balance, and coordination to superhuman levels. This ability allows the character to navigate their environment with effortless grace, whether leaping across rooftops, scaling sheer walls, or dodging enemy attacks with lightning-fast movements. Lupine Agility makes the character a master of movement, able to traverse any terrain with fluid precision.
When Lupine Agility is activated, the character moves with an elegance that is almost otherworldly. Their body becomes a blur as they dash through obstacles, each motion perfectly controlled and balanced. To onlookers, the character seems to defy gravity, their movements a seamless dance of agility and power. The air swirls around them as they leap from one point to another, their landings as soft and silent as a shadow. The character's heightened senses pick up every detail of their surroundings, allowing them to react with uncanny speed to any threat or opportunity.
In the midst of battle, Lupine Agility turns the character into a swift and elusive predator, their movements too fast and too fluid to be easily tracked or targeted. This ability not only enhances their combat effectiveness but also reinforces their role as a deadly and unpredictable force, capable of striking from any angle and evading danger with ease.

powers.name: Lycanthropy
powers.effect: Transform into: Dire Wolf: MR(12), [Jumps(🏃+2)], bite [Atk/Dmg(💪)/(💪+1)]; if hit -> Bite can Latch for [Dmg(💪)] each round.
powers.notes:
Lycanthropy is the signature ability of the character, allowing them to transform into various forms, including the Dire Wolf, Fenrir Wolf, Werewolf, or even a pack of wolves. This shape-shifting power grants the character unparalleled versatility, enabling them to adapt to any situation or threat with remarkable ease. Each form offers unique advantages, making Lycanthropy an essential tool for the character in both combat and survival.
The transformation triggered by Lycanthropy is a mesmerizing and fearsome spectacle. The character's body twists and reshapes in an instant, muscles and bones contorting to fit the chosen form. Their skin ripples and fur sprouts in waves, while their eyes glow with a fierce, predatory light. The air is filled with the sound of cracking bones and tearing flesh, but the process is seamless and fluid, almost as if the character is shedding one skin for another. To those witnessing the transformation, it is both a display of raw power and a reminder of the character's connection to the primal forces of nature.
At its peak, Lycanthropy makes the character an unstoppable force, able to shift between forms to best suit the needs of the moment. Whether tearing through enemies as a fearsome wolf or overwhelming foes with the coordinated attack of a pack, the character's ability to transform ensures they remain a dominant predator, feared and respected by all.

powers.name: Magnetic Pulse
powers.effect: Set an anchor mark, all in Tight radius AoE ferrous weapons/shields: [Pulled(💪)]^💪 or fly to mark. Mostly ferrous armor: [Pull Prone(💪)]^💪 or fall prone toward Mark.
powers.notes:
Magnetic Pulse is a versatile ability that enables the character to manipulate magnetic fields, disarming enemies of ferrous weapons and destabilizing those wearing ferrous armor. By harnessing the power of magnetism, the character can create both offensive and defensive opportunities, disrupting enemy formations and leaving them vulnerable to attack.
Upon activation, the air around the character crackles with energy, and a focused pulse of magnetic force radiates out from the chosen point of impact. Ferrous weapons and armor within the affected area begin to vibrate violently, emitting a high-pitched whine as they are wrenched from their owners’ grasp or pulled forcefully toward the designated Mark. The metallic objects seem to take on a life of their own, twisting and contorting as they are dragged across the battlefield. Those wearing heavy armor find themselves pulled off balance, crashing to the ground as the magnetic force overpowers their strength. The Mark itself glows faintly, a beacon of concentrated magnetic energy that draws metal toward it with irresistible force.
Magnetic Pulse turns the enemy's own equipment into a liability, using the power of magnetism to disrupt and control the battlefield in the character’s favor.

powers.name: Magnetic Repulsor
powers.effect: [Repel Projectile(✨)]^Atk vs ferrous projectile; ferrous melee Wnds/2.
powers.notes:
Magnetic Repulsor is a defensive ability that allows the character to generate a powerful magnetic field, repelling incoming ferrous projectiles and reducing the damage from ferrous melee weapons. This protective aura not only deflects attacks but can also reflect projectiles back at the attacker, turning their own weapons against them. The Magnetic Repulsor is a crucial tool for the character, providing both defense and counterattack capabilities against metal-based threats.
When Magnetic Repulsor is activated, a shimmering, translucent field of energy envelops the character, its surface crackling with magnetic sparks. The air around the character hums with power, and any ferrous projectile that comes within range is suddenly deflected with a sharp, metallic clang, often hurtling back toward the attacker with deadly precision. The repulsor field glows faintly, its surface rippling as it absorbs and disperses the force of incoming attacks. As ferrous melee weapons strike the character, they seem to lose their momentum, the impact softened as the magnetic field dissipates their energy.
Magnetic Repulsor allows the character to turn the enemy’s strength against them, using the power of magnetism to defend and retaliate with deadly efficiency.

powers.name: Mantis Targeter
powers.effect: Flies MR(3); shot weapons only: shot weapon gains [Atk/Dmg(👁️+1)/(👁️)]
powers.notes:
Mantis Targeter is a specialized ability of the character, enabling them to deploy a praying mantis-like creature that enhances the accuracy of missile weapons. The mantis forms a strong psionic link with its host’s mind, fine-tuning the weapon’s aim and improving the host’s agility during the aiming process. This ability is invaluable for increasing the effectiveness of ranged attacks, ensuring that each shot is more precise and deadly.
When Mantis Targeter is activated, the mantis creature, with its sleek, segmented body and translucent wings, flies swiftly to the designated missile weapon. Upon landing, it attaches itself to the weapon, its legs gripping the surface with a delicate yet unyielding hold. The mantis’s wings flutter as it synchronizes with the host’s mind, its compound eyes glowing faintly as it taps into the host’s targeting thoughts. The weapon feels almost alive in the host’s hands, responding with enhanced precision as the mantis subtly adjusts its aim. With each shot, the mantis’s influence is felt, guiding the projectile with unnerving accuracy, whether in daylight or darkness.
Mantis Targeter is a powerful enhancement, turning even the most ordinary missile weapon into a precision tool of destruction, perfectly aligned with the host’s intentions.

powers.notes:
Mesmerise is a powerful Shadow Magic ability that allows the character to exert control over a target through dark hypnotic influence. When activated, the character's eyes emit a supernatural glow that draws the victim's gaze into a shadowy abyss, compelling them to listen and obey. This ability induces a trance-like state in the target, rendering them highly susceptible to the character's commands. The target becomes a puppet to the character’s will, unable to resist the overwhelming mental force.
As the character locks eyes with their target, a deep, shadowy glow emanates from their gaze, pulling the victim into a hypnotic trance. The victim’s eyes glaze over as they fall under the character’s spell, their mind bending to the character’s will. The character can then issue commands, ranging from simple orders to complex instructions, depending on the level of the ability. The victim, unable to resist, carries out these commands with unquestioning obedience, becoming an unwitting tool in the character’s hands. Whether compelling the target to reveal secrets, hold still for an attack, or even protect the character, Mesmerise is a versatile and dangerous tool for manipulation and control.
Mesmerise showcases the character’s mastery over the minds of others, allowing them to turn enemies into allies or puppets with a single, hypnotic gaze. This ability ensures that the character can manipulate the battlefield to their advantage, using their enemies’ own minds against them.

powers.name: Molten Core

powers.notes:
Molten Core is an advanced enhancement for the character’s Thermite Grenades, designed to significantly increase the destructive power of each explosive. When activated, this ability channels additional energy into the thermite, causing it to adhere to the target on impact. This results in an exceptionally intense burn that not only causes an initial explosion but also continues to inflict damage over time. The thermite’s relentless burn can melt through armor, flesh, and fortifications, making it an extremely effective tool for sustained damage on the battlefield.
Visually, when Molten Core is activated, the thermite within the grenade glows with a bright, molten orange hue, radiating intense heat. Upon detonation, the thermite splashes onto the target, clinging to surfaces and burning with a fierce, unyielding flame. The effect is a terrifying spectacle, with the target engulfed in flames that continue to eat away at them, reducing metal and stone to molten slag, while the intense heat distorts the air around it. This lingering burn serves as a constant threat, ensuring that the target remains vulnerable as the damage persists, making each Molten Core-enhanced grenade a long-lasting weapon of devastation.
As the character’s mastery of Molten Core advances, each grenade becomes a blazing engine of unstoppable destruction, melting everything in its path.

powers.notes:
The Nano-Scope is a cutting-edge enhancement for the character’s weapon, transforming a standard scope into a sophisticated tool that enhances vision and detection capabilities. This nano-tech marvel allows the character to spot hidden threats, identify weaknesses, and track targets at extreme distances with precision.
When the Nano-Scope is activated, nanobots quickly assemble or enhance the existing scope, projecting a translucent HUD that overlays crucial data onto the character’s view. Heat signatures, movement patterns, and structural weaknesses are highlighted in vivid detail, allowing the character to line up the perfect shot. The scope’s range and damage potential are significantly enhanced, turning the character into an unparalleled scout and sniper, capable of seeing through obstacles and pinpointing enemy positions with deadly accuracy.
With the Nano-Scope, the character gains the ability to see beyond the visible, turning every shot into a calculated and lethal strike.
