powers.notes:
Nature's Wrath is a formidable ability that allows the character to summon a massive, tentacle-like vine-arm covered in deadly thorns. This powerful force of nature bursts forth from the ground, targeting a single enemy with devastating blows, embodying the raw, untamed power of nature.
When Nature's Wrath is unleashed, the earth splits open with a violent crack, and from the depths emerges a colossal vine-arm, its surface bristling with razor-sharp thorns. The vine writhes with a life of its own, its movements purposeful and menacing as it seeks out its designated target. The air is filled with the sound of creaking wood and the hiss of thorny tendrils as the vine lashes out, delivering crushing blows that send shockwaves through the ground. The vine's strikes are relentless, each impact reverberating with the raw power of nature itself, leaving the target battered and broken under its unyielding assault.
Nature's Wrath turns the tide of battle by transforming nature into a weapon of immense destructive potential, ensuring that no enemy can escape its relentless grasp.

powers.name: Necro Skin
powers.effect: If caster is attacked with body weapon (touched): [Necrosis(✨)]^✨ → [1d4] Wnds/rnd, cummulative, so if a 2nd Atk and  [Necrosis(✨)]^✨then [2d4], etc.
powers.notes:
Necro Skin is a terrifying ability that allows the character to infuse their flesh with potent necrotic energy, turning their skin into a deadly defensive weapon. Any physical contact with the character's skin initiates a sinister transfer of this energy, forcing the target to save or contract a severe necrotic curse. The infection rapidly deteriorates the target's flesh, causing excruciating pain and ongoing damage each round for a set duration. This ability not only enhances the character’s defensive capabilities but also instills fear in their enemies, knowing that even a touch can lead to a slow, agonizing demise.
As Necro Skin takes effect, the character’s skin darkens and takes on an eerie, mottled appearance, as if imbued with death itself. Any foe who dares to strike the character with bare flesh or light armor feels the necrotic energy seeping into their body, causing immediate and severe pain. The necrosis spreads quickly, weakening the victim as their flesh deteriorates and their vitality drains away. This curse lingers, causing ongoing damage and potentially incapacitating the victim over time. Necro Skin turns the character into a walking plague, their very touch a death sentence for those foolish enough to engage them in close combat.
Necro Skin underscores the character’s lethal nature, turning their body into a weapon that inflicts pain and suffering on any who dare to strike them. This ability ensures that the character remains a formidable force on the battlefield, capable of turning the tide of combat with a single touch.

powers.name: Necrosis
powers.effect: Each wounding hit with the same weapon vs the same taget causes +5 Wnds cummulative unless [Necrosis(✨+2)]^🫀
powers.notes:
Necrosis is a terrifying ability that transforms the character's Red Whip into a weapon of relentless life drain, a manifestation of their vampiric power. When activated, Necrosis inflicts a debilitating condition upon its victims, causing their vitality to decay steadily over time. Each strike with the Red Whip becomes more than just a physical attack—it marks the beginning of a slow, inevitable decline for the target, as their life force is sapped away with every passing moment. This condition is nearly impossible to cure, making it a formidable tool in the character’s arsenal.
Visually, Necrosis manifests as a dark, creeping energy that spreads from the point of contact, suffusing the target’s body with a sickly, pulsating glow. The victim’s flesh may blacken and wither where the whip strikes, as if being consumed by an invisible, corrosive force. Each subsequent strike intensifies this effect, as the necrotic energy compounds, accelerating the rate of decay. The target's life force seems to be drawn out of them, leaving them increasingly frail and vulnerable, their movements becoming sluggish as the necrosis spreads.
Necrosis exemplifies the character’s ability to dominate the battlefield through attrition, turning every strike into a lingering death sentence. As the necrotic energy takes hold, the victim's strength wanes, their life slipping away bit by bit, until there is nothing left but a hollow shell, drained of all vitality.

powers.name: Necrotic Fortitude
powers.effect: Regenerate 1 2nd Deg wound each round. Immune to poison, disease, vacuum; cannot bleed.
powers.notes:
Necrotic Fortitude is an ability that reflects the character's undead-like nature, granting them a host of resistances and immunities that set them apart from living beings. This ability renders the wraith impervious to poison, disease, extreme temperatures, and even the vacuum of space. The character no longer requires food, water, or air to survive, allowing them to exist indefinitely without sustenance. In addition, Necrotic Fortitude prevents the character from bleeding and ensures that once they are dead, they can only be revived through arcane means, not by typical or advanced scientific methods.
When Necrotic Fortitude is active, the character exudes an aura of deathly calm, their body seemingly untouched by the elements or the passage of time. Their skin takes on a pallor that hints at their undead nature, and their movements are slow and deliberate, as though they are conserving their energy for the moment when it is needed most. To those around them, the character appears as a being that is no longer tethered to the mortal plane, a wraith that has transcended the need for physical sustenance and is impervious to the dangers that would kill a living being. The character's wounds, if they occur, do not bleed, and their lifeless form does not slump or fall, instead remaining eerily still as if they are simply waiting for the right moment to strike again.
Necrotic Fortitude underscores the character's detachment from the mortal world, granting them a resilience that is both terrifying and awe-inspiring, as they endure where others would fall.

powers.name: Necrovision
powers.effect: Perceive (see) life/death (in monochrome) at [Necrovision(✨)]. Vs sealed or inanimate is Dis.
powers.notes:
Necrovision is a supernatural ability that grants the character the power to perceive the ebb and flow of life and death in all forms. This ability allows the character to see the vital essence of living beings, detecting even the faintest traces of life, down to microbes and viruses. Through Necrovision, the world appears in varying shades of vitality, with vibrant life forms glowing brightly and inanimate objects appearing dim and lifeless. This ability grants the wraith an unparalleled understanding of the balance between life and death, enabling them to navigate and interact with their environment with eerie precision.
When the character activates Necrovision, their eyes glow with an unnatural light, as though they are peering into another plane of existence. The world around them shifts into monochrome, with shades of grey representing the various levels of life force present in the environment. Living beings appear as bright, glowing figures, their life force pulsing with every heartbeat. Inanimate objects, on the other hand, appear as dim, shadowy outlines, barely visible against the backdrop of the living world. The character can see through most forms of concealment, detecting life even when it is hidden behind walls or other obstacles. However, sealed barriers, such as glass or force fields, render Necrovision ineffective, leaving the character blind to the life beyond them.
Necrovision grants the character the ability to see the world in a way that is both eerie and enlightening, allowing them to detect life in all its forms and navigate the battlefield with a precision that is unmatched by the living.

powers.notes:
Neurotoxin Stun is a potent ability of the character’s Bio-Vine Whip, designed to incapacitate foes with a single strike. When activated, the Bio-Vine Whip releases a specialized neurotoxin upon contact, targeting the nervous system of the victim. This toxin is expertly engineered to induce a temporary paralysis, stunning the target and rendering them immobile for the duration of the effect.
As the neurotoxin courses through the target’s body, it spreads like wildfire, quickly paralyzing their muscles and leaving them helpless. The effects are almost immediate, with the target’s limbs seizing up and their body going rigid as the poison takes hold. The whip itself seems to pulse with a faint green glow as the toxin is delivered, a visual cue to the power and precision of the character’s strike. The target’s eyes widen in panic as they realize they are completely at the mercy of the character’s command, unable to move or resist.
With Neurotoxin Stun, the character can turn the tide of conflict with a well-timed strike, showcasing their mastery over both nature and combat.

powers.notes:
Pack Tactics is a strategic ability that allows the character to coordinate attacks and defenses with their allies, amplifying their effectiveness on the battlefield. This ability is a testament to the power of teamwork, as the character and their allies work in perfect unison to overwhelm their enemies. Pack Tactics is more than just a coordination of effort—it is a merging of minds and wills, creating a cohesive unit that moves and strikes as one.
When Pack Tactics is activated, a faint, glowing aura connects the character and their allies, symbolizing their shared purpose and unity. This aura pulses with a rhythmic energy, synchronizing their movements and attacks. To those within the connection, there is a heightened sense of awareness and anticipation, as if they can feel each other's intentions before they are even fully formed. The character's commands are understood instinctively, and their allies respond with perfect precision. As they move in tandem, their combined strength and ferocity become a formidable force, striking their enemies with a coordinated onslaught that is impossible to withstand.
At its peak, Pack Tactics turns the character and their allies into an unstoppable pack, where each member's strengths are magnified through unity and cooperation. This ability ensures that the character's pack is more than just a group of individuals—it is a single, powerful entity capable of dominating the battlefield through sheer, collective might.

The character’s movements are fluid, their sword tracing arcs of glowing energy as it meets and redirects every threat. To onlookers, the character appears untouchable, a master of defense whose every motion is a seamless blend of instinct and practiced skill, turning their blade into an extension of their will.
Parry Mastery transforms the character into a nearly invincible force, where even the most ferocious of assaults are met with calm, controlled deflection, leaving the character unscathed and ready to counter.

Phantom Cloak is a sophisticated stealth ability that allows the character to blend seamlessly into their surroundings, becoming nearly invisible to both the naked eye and most detection systems. This ability is crucial for ambushes, stealth missions, and surprise attacks, enabling the character to move undetected and strike with lethal precision.
When Phantom Cloak is activated, a field of refractive light and energy envelops the character, bending the light around them and making them disappear from view. As they move through enemy lines, their presence is undetectable, and their steps leave no sound. When the character strikes from this hidden position, their attacks are devastatingly effective, delivering precision blows with increased accuracy and damage, often before the enemy even realizes they are there.
Phantom Cloak transforms the character into an unseen predator, capable of eliminating targets with a level of stealth and precision that inspires fear in the hearts of their enemies.

powers.name: Phantom Glide

powers.notes:
Phantom Glide is an ethereal movement ability that allows the character to move with near-silent grace, traversing delicate surfaces such as water, oil, or snow without leaving a trace. This ability allows the wraith to glide effortlessly across the battlefield, avoiding detection and maintaining perfect balance even in the most precarious situations. However, the character's movement is limited to a slow, steady pace, as they cannot jump or run while using Phantom Glide, and they are vulnerable to strong winds and concussive forces.
When the character activates Phantom Glide, their movements become almost imperceptible, as though they are floating just above the ground. Their feet leave no ripples on the surface of water, no marks on the snow, and no sound in the air. They move with the grace of a ghost, slipping through the battlefield like a wraith, unseen and unheard. However, this graceful movement comes at a cost, as the character cannot move quickly or make sudden movements. They must remain steady and controlled, as any attempt to jump or run would break the illusion of their ghostly glide. Despite this limitation, Phantom Glide grants the character an unparalleled ability to move through the world with an otherworldly grace that few can match.
Phantom Glide transforms the character into a spectral figure, moving through the battlefield with the silent grace of a ghost, untouchable by the physical world but vulnerable to the forces that would disrupt their delicate balance.

Unlike traditional attacks, the damage dealt by Phasing Thrust is not rolled; instead, the blade inflicts a guaranteed number of wounds, ensuring that the strike is as lethal as it is precise. As the character hones their mastery of this ability, the number of wounds inflicted increases, making Phasing Thrust an increasingly potent tool for eliminating even the most heavily armored foes.
Phasing Thrust allows the character to deliver fatal blows with unerring accuracy, turning each strike into a guaranteed kill.

Pitfall is a cunning and strategic ability of the character, allowing them to create hidden traps that ensnare unsuspecting enemies and protect their allies. This ability conjures a concealed pit beneath a designated area, which remains hidden until triggered by unsuspecting targets. The pitfall is designed to capture all who fall into it, making it an effective tool for halting advances and isolating enemies.
When the character casts Pitfall, the ground beneath the designated area ripples momentarily before returning to its natural state, leaving no visible trace of the trap. The pit remains hidden, waiting for the moment when an enemy steps onto it. As soon as it is triggered, the earth gives way with a sudden, sickening lurch, and the unsuspecting target plummets into a deep pit. The sides of the pit are smooth and nearly impossible to climb, often coated in slick oil or lined with jagged stalagmites, making escape even more challenging. The pit itself is dark and foreboding, with only the faintest glimmers of light reflecting off the treacherous obstacles within.
Pitfall is a versatile and dangerous ability, allowing the character to control the battlefield by creating deadly traps that hinder, delay, and demoralize their enemies.

Their vision sharpens, colors become more vivid, and sounds more distinct, creating a heightened awareness of their surroundings. This ability gives the character unparalleled control over the battlefield, enabling them to use these rifts for rapid movement, strategic positioning, or creating deadly traps for their enemies. Rift Tear turns the battlefield into a web of dimensional gates, all controlled by the character’s will.
When the character tears reality apart, the air around them seems to crackle and distort, as if reality itself is being pulled and twisted by an unseen force. The rifts appear as jagged, shimmering portals, each one unique to the observer, with edges that ripple like the surface of a disturbed pond. Through these rifts, the character can see the connected locations, the portals acting as windows to different parts of the battlefield. The rifts hum with a low, resonant vibration that seems to reverberate through the very air, making the character’s presence palpable across the battlefield. Enemies find themselves disoriented and confused, unable to predict where the character or their allies will strike next, as the battlefield becomes a shifting maze of interlinked dimensions.
Rift Tear allows the character to reshape the battlefield itself, turning it into a chaotic landscape where every move is a potential ambush and every escape is a step closer to the void.

Rockslide is a formidable ability of the character, allowing them to summon a devastating cascade of rocks, boulders, dirt, and debris that crushes enemies and creates strategic barriers. This ability channels the raw power of the earth to inflict significant damage on those caught in its path and to obstruct enemy movement. The cascade of rocks and dirt fills the targeted area, creating a mass of rubble that towers over the battlefield. The sound of the rocks colliding is deafening, and the air is thick with dust and debris, making it difficult to see or breathe. By anchoring the target to the ground and enveloping them in thick, protective roots, the character drastically enhances their armor, making them capable of withstanding even the most formidable attacks. This ability taps into the character's deep connection with nature, drawing strength from the earth to turn the target into a living bastion of defense.
When Rooted Armor is cast, the ground beneath the ally trembles before thick, gnarled roots burst forth, coiling around their legs and torso. The roots are dark, with patches of moss and small leaves growing along their length, and they pulse with a faint, green light as they fuse with the ally’s armor, hardening into a nearly impenetrable barrier. The ally feels the strength of the earth itself coursing through them, making them a steadfast wall against any assault, though their movements become slow and deliberate as the roots anchor them in place.
Rooted Armor transforms the chosen ally into a living fortress, an immovable bulwark that can turn the tide of battle by absorbing blows that would fell even the mightiest warriors.

When activated, the character alters the floor beneath their enemies, turning solid earthen surfaces into loose, shifting sand. The solid earth softens and gives way, transforming into a vast expanse of loose sand that shifts and flows like water with every step. The sand is pale and fine, swirling around the feet of those trapped within, making every movement feel sluggish and labored. The soft, whispering sound of sand shifting fills the air, creating a disorienting and eerie atmosphere. For those caught within the Sand Dune, every step becomes a struggle, their movements slow and unsteady, while the character moves freely, unaffected by the shifting terrain.
Sand Dune is an ideal tool for controlling the battlefield, slowing down enemy advances, and setting up devastating attacks in an environment where the character reigns supreme.

Scorpion’s Sting is a lethal enhancement for the Venom Injector Carbine, infusing each shot with a virulent toxin that delivers progressively devastating damage over time. When a target is wounded by the carbine, the toxin takes immediate effect, inflicting an additional wound on impact. However, the true power of Scorpion’s Sting lies in its lingering effect: the venom continues to ravage the target’s body, causing a series of increasingly severe wounds over subsequent rounds.
When Scorpion’s Sting is activated, the venom inside the bio-darts is enhanced, taking on a faint, ominous glow. Upon impact, the toxin spreads through the target’s body like wildfire, causing an immediate surge of pain followed by a slow, agonizing deterioration. The venom burns through the victim’s veins, each wave of damage more intense than the last, as if the venom itself is alive, seeking out every vital organ and nerve ending. The target’s skin may darken or blister at the injection site, and they may experience tremors, paralysis, or seizures as the toxin takes hold.
Scorpion’s Sting ensures that even a single hit from the Venom Injector Carbine can turn the tide of battle, delivering a slow but inexorable death to those unfortunate enough to be struck.

Searing Vortex is a potent ability of the Flame Lance, allowing the character to generate a whirling maelstrom of plasma energy. This vortex draws in surrounding energy and intense heat, creating a powerful, searing force that seeks out enemies within its range. The vortex can be summoned directly upon a target or allowed to move autonomously toward the nearest enemy, making it a versatile tool for both direct assaults and area control.

The vortex appears as a concentrated whirlwind of flames, moving with purpose across the battlefield. As it locks onto an enemy, the vortex's intensity heightens, and the air around it crackles with heat, signaling the impending attack. Multiple vortexes can be summoned across different rounds, creating a chaotic and overwhelming presence on the battlefield, each one relentlessly pursuing and damaging foes.
With the Searing Vortex, the character can command the battlefield with lethal precision, turning the Flame Lance into a weapon of relentless pursuit and fiery devastation.

powers.notes:
Shadow Beast is a mystical ability that allows the character to summon a companion from the depths of the Nightmare Realm, a shadowy creature that embodies the dark, primal forces the character commands. Each Shadow Beast is more than just a creature—it is an extension of the character’s will, summoned to aid in tasks ranging from combat to stealth. The character can choose from various shadowy forms, each with unique abilities, ensuring they are always equipped with the right ally for the situation.
When a Shadow Beast is summoned, the air grows cold, and a dark mist seeps from the ground, swirling and coalescing into the chosen form. The shadows around the character seem to bend and twist, drawn to the summoning point as if compelled by an unseen force. Slowly, the mist takes shape, solidifying into a creature of pure darkness. Its eyes, black orbs with a small yellow pupil, glow faintly as it materializes, a silent yet imposing presence. The creature moves with an unnatural fluidity, its body shifting and blending with the shadows as it prepares to carry out the character's commands. To onlookers, the Shadow Beast is both eerie and mesmerizing, a living embodiment of the darkness that surrounds it.
At its height, Shadow Beast grants the character a loyal and versatile companion, one that is capable of performing tasks with the same efficiency and stealth that defines the character itself. This ability reinforces the character's connection to the Nightmare Realm, ensuring they are never truly alone on the battlefield, always accompanied by a creature born of shadow and darkness.
Shadow Beasts:
-- Night Raven: The Night Raven flies swiftly and silently, carrying messages across great distances or scouting ahead to warn the character of potential dangers. The night raven can understand the character and can speak simple phrase to the target.
-- Shadow Wolf: The Shadow Wolf serves as a fierce combatant, fighting alongside the character with relentless ferocity and tracking down enemies with its enhanced senses.
-- Shade Ferret: The Shade Ferret is adept at infiltration, using its slender, shadowy body to adeptly climb and slip into tight spaces and pickpockets and pick locks, and retrieve small items, enabling the character to bypass obstacles and barriers.
-- Eclipse Panther: The Eclipse Panther excels in stealth and unknown attacks, using its shadowy form to slip through enemy lines unnoticed, ideal for espionage or retrieving hidden objects.
-- Umbral Bear: The Umbral Bear acts as a stalwart guardian, using its massive, shadowy form to defend the character and their allies, Taunting enemies and absorbing damage to hold the line in battle. Taunt is Sk()^Men or will significantly prefer the taunter over all other targets.

Shadow Blade is an advanced technique that allows the character to summon a secondary shadow attack mere milliseconds after the primary strike. This secondary attack originates from a different angle, making it incredibly difficult for the target to defend against, and significantly increasing the chances of landing a critical blow.
As the character executes a strike, the Shadow Blade technique triggers, causing a dark, shimmering afterimage to materialize beside the original blade. This shadowy duplicate mirrors the initial attack but from an unexpected direction, slicing through the air with eerie silence. The target, already reeling from the first blow, is caught off guard as the shadow strike lands, the unexpected angle making it nearly impossible to defend. To onlookers, the character appears to wield two blades at once, one real and one spectral, both moving in perfect harmony to overwhelm the enemy with a flurry of attacks.
Shadow Blade enhances the character’s offensive capabilities, turning each strike into a deadly combination of speed, precision, and surprise, leaving enemies defenseless against the relentless onslaught.

powers.notes:
Shadow Flicker is an exceptional defensive ability that allows the character to evade attacks with superhuman speed. By harnessing the power of nano-elementals within their blood, the character’s neural processing and muscle responsiveness are dramatically enhanced, enabling them to react to threats with near-instantaneous precision. During Shadow Flicker, the character’s movements become so rapid and precise that they appear to flicker in and out of sight, dodging bullets, melee strikes, and other attacks with ease.
As Shadow Flicker is activated, the character’s form blurs and flickers, creating the illusion of multiple dodge poses at once. Their enemies find it nearly impossible to land a hit, as the character’s body seems to phase through attacks, evading them with supernatural agility. This ability significantly boosts the character’s defense, making them nearly untouchable in the heat of battle. Shadow Flicker can also be used in conjunction with the Dark Form (Wraith), allowing the character to maintain this heightened state of defense while remaining a lethal force on the battlefield.
Shadow Flicker ensures that the character remains elusive and difficult to hit, making it an essential tool for survival and dominance in combat. This ability allows them to evade even the most precise attacks, ensuring that they can continue to fight with confidence, knowing that they are always one step ahead of their enemies.

The shadows ripple with every movement, making it difficult for enemies to discern the character's true position, as if they are being watched by unseen eyes from every angle.

Shadow Meld is an ability that allows the character to vanish into the shadows, effectively teleporting to a shadowy area and becoming invisible for a short period. This power is perfect for setting up ambushes or escaping dangerous situations, as it renders the character impervious to damage and effects while they are in the Shadow Realm. When activated, the character disappears from the battlefield, slipping into the shadowy dimensions where no physical or magical attack can reach them. This ability provides the character with a tactical advantage, allowing them to reposition themselves unseen and strike from the shadows with deadly precision.
As the character activates Shadow Meld, their form dissolves into the darkness, leaving only a faint ripple in the air where they once stood. Within the Shadow Realm, they are aware of their surroundings but untouchable, a ghostly presence lurking just out of sight. When they choose to reappear, they do so in a shadowy square of their choosing, emerging from the darkness to unleash a surprise attack or to escape to safety. Shadow Meld is the ultimate tool for evasion and stealth, allowing the character to remain elusive and unpredictable on the battlefield.
Shadow Meld embodies the character’s connection to the darkness, allowing them to use the shadows as both a shield and a weapon. This ability ensures that the character can always find a way to escape danger or to launch a surprise attack, making them a formidable and elusive opponent.

Using this enhancement, a psionicist shoves a target with the sheer force of mind. The psionicist must roll Sk^Str. If successful, the target is shoved in the direction, and up to the Max distance, shown. Shove’s primary function is to move/relocate friendly or hostile targets as desired. As the character spins into action, their movements become a blur of claws and fury, cutting down anything in their path. The Shredding Cyclone allows the character to distribute their attacks among multiple foes, overwhelming them with a series of rapid, devastating strikes. The battlefield becomes a maelstrom of blood and steel as the character tears through their enemies with unrelenting savagery.

Footsteps, weapon clicks, and even spoken words are contained within the bubble, preventing any noise from escaping and alerting enemies. The character can move freely within this silent sphere, confident that their actions will go unnoticed by those outside the field. The target feels the ground give way beneath them, and they are quickly pulled downward, the cool, gritty sand closing over their legs and torso with a relentless grip. The surface of the quicksand churns and ripples as the target struggles, but the more they fight, the deeper they sink. The sand is thick and heavy, clinging to their skin and clothing, making every movement a battle against the earth itself. For those unfortunate enough to fail their saves, the quicksand engulfs them entirely, leaving nothing but a few bubbles and the faint impression of their struggle on the surface.
Sinkhole is an exceptional ability for isolating and incapacitating enemies, turning the very ground beneath them into a deadly trap that swallows them whole.

Sniper’s Climb is a specialized ability designed for the character, allowing them to ascend to high vantage points with exceptional speed and stealth. This ability is crucial when the character needs to reach a strategic position to execute a long-range attack or set up a Sniper’s Shot.
When Sniper’s Climb is activated, the character’s body moves with fluid precision, scaling walls, cliffs, and obstacles with effortless grace. The sound of their movements is muffled by the advanced technology in their gear, making them nearly invisible as they ascend. Upon reaching their perch, the character blends into the environment, their presence undetectable as they prepare to take their shot. The enhanced stealth during and after the climb ensures that the character remains hidden, turning any high ground into a deadly vantage point.
Sniper’s Climb allows the character to strike from the perfect position, ensuring their targets never see the attack coming.

Sniper’s Perch is a portable, telescoping platform that allows the character to create an elevated position for long-range attacks. This device is designed for rapid deployment, enabling the character to establish a stable perch on almost any vertical surface, perfect for sniping or observation.
When Sniper’s Perch is deployed, the character activates a small rod that quickly extends and anchors to the chosen surface using a Q-Bond field. The rod unfolds into a 2x4 ft platform, which auto-levels to provide a stable base for the character. Whether attached to a high wall, tree, or cliffside, the perch allows the character to position themselves perfectly for a long-range shot. The platform is sturdy enough to support the character and their equipment, providing a secure vantage point from which to engage targets or observe the battlefield.
With Sniper’s Perch, the character can strike from above, taking advantage of the high ground to deliver precise, devastating attacks on their enemies.

Sniper’s Shot is an elite ability that empowers the character to deliver a devastating, precision missile attack from a hidden position. This ability is designed for covert eliminations, allowing the character to take out targets with lethal efficiency before they are even aware of the danger.
When Sniper’s Shot is activated, the character’s breath steadies, and their focus narrows to a single point. Hidden from view, the character lines up their shot with painstaking precision, their weapon’s targeting systems locking onto the unsuspecting target. As the trigger is pulled, the missile streaks silently through the air, striking with such force that the target has no time to react. The wounds inflicted are multiplied, ensuring that the target is neutralized in one powerful strike.
Sniper’s Shot transforms the character into a master marksman, capable of eliminating high-value targets with a single, precise shot.

Spider Armor is a unique and formidable ability of the character, allowing them to create a large, spider-like exoskeleton that rapidly scampers to a designated target and envelops them in a protective bio-engineered shell. This exoskeleton significantly enhances the target’s resilience, providing critical protection on the battlefield. Spider Armor is designed to shield allies from harm, enabling them to endure more damage and continue fighting effectively.
Upon activation, the Spider Armor scuttles with alarming speed toward its designated target, its multiple legs moving in a blur of motion. As it reaches the target, the armor’s legs extend, wrapping around the body with an almost predatory precision. The exoskeleton hardens instantly, its surface covered in dark, chitinous plates that interlock seamlessly to form an impenetrable barrier. The target, now encased in the Spider Armor, feels an immediate surge in their defenses, the armor’s bio-nanites reinforcing their body’s natural resilience. The armor’s presence is both awe-inspiring and terrifying, especially to those unfamiliar with its purpose, as it transforms the wearer into a fearsome, spider-like warrior.
Spider Armor is an essential defensive tool for the character, offering a terrifyingly effective way to shield allies from the dangers of battle, and ensuring they remain a steadfast force on the front lines.

The air becomes heavy with the scent of damp earth and decaying vegetation, making it difficult to breathe. Those trapped inside the cloud find their vision completely obscured, the world around them reduced to shadowy shapes and muffled sounds. The disorienting effects of the spores cause movements to become sluggish and erratic, as if the very air is pulling them in different directions.
Spore Cloud transforms the battlefield into a treacherous environment where the character and their allies can maneuver with greater freedom, while enemies are left vulnerable and disoriented, lost in the choking mist.

When summoned, the ground beneath the target rumbles ominously before a massive stone hand bursts forth, its surface rough and jagged, as if carved from the earth itself. The hand moves with surprising agility, its stone fingers curling and uncurling as it prepares to strike. When it smashes down on a target, the impact reverberates through the ground with a deep, resonant thud, sending shockwaves through the earth. If the Stone Fist grabs a target, the grip is unyielding, the rough stone digging into flesh and armor alike, holding the enemy in place or crushing them with relentless pressure. The hand remains anchored to the spot where it was summoned, its presence a constant, menacing threat to any who come within its reach.
Stone Fist exemplifies the character’s ability to harness the raw power of the earth, turning the very ground beneath their enemies into a weapon of immense strength and brutality.

Stone Skin is a crucial defensive tool in the character’s arsenal, turning them into a living bastion of stone that can weather the fiercest of storms.

Subdermal Armor is a robust defensive ability that enhances the character's resilience by embedding reinforced plating beneath their skin. This subdermal reinforcement provides additional protection against explosive, blunt, and chop damage, significantly reducing the impact of these types of attacks. Subdermal Armor ensures that the character can withstand intense physical punishment while maintaining their combat effectiveness in the heat of battle.
When Subdermal Armor is activated, the character’s skin takes on a subtly reinforced appearance, as if the very structure beneath has been fortified with a layer of protective plating. Explosions, heavy blows, and chopping attacks that would normally cause significant damage are absorbed and dispersed by the subdermal armor, leaving the character largely unharmed. As the character’s proficiency with this ability increases, the armor’s effectiveness grows, providing even greater resistance to these damaging effects.
At its peak, Subdermal Armor transforms the character into a resilient and enduring warrior, capable of surviving the most brutal combat situations with ease.

Summon Golem is a powerful ability that allows the character to conjure a formidable earth golem to fight by their side. This massive construct, made from the very earth itself, serves as a loyal and nearly indestructible ally, capable of both defending the character and engaging in direct combat with foes. The golem follows the character's commands, providing both offensive and defensive support on the battlefield.
When the golem is summoned, the ground beneath the character trembles and cracks, and a massive figure begins to rise from the earth. The golem takes shape as a towering, humanoid figure, its body composed of solid stone and packed earth, with veins of glowing crystal running through its limbs and chest. The golem’s eyes glow with a soft, amber light, and its movements are slow but deliberate, each step causing the ground to shake. As it moves, the sound of grinding stone echoes across the battlefield, and the air around it seems to vibrate with the weight of its presence. In combat, the golem’s fists strike with the force of a landslide, delivering powerful blows that can shatter armor and crush enemies.
Summon Golem embodies the character’s mastery over the earth, bringing forth a powerful ally to aid them in battle, ensuring that they are never alone on the field of war.

powers.notes:
Symbiotic Boost is an advanced bioengineering ability employed by the character, allowing them to summon and apply specially configured bio-animals, known as symbiotes, to enhance the physical or mental attributes of an ally. Each symbiote is uniquely designed to provide specific boosts, significantly improving the ally’s combat effectiveness, cognitive abilities, or overall resilience. This ability transforms an ordinary ally into a formidable force on the battlefield, tailored to meet the immediate demands of combat or strategy.
When Symbiotic Boost is activated, the character summons a symbiote from within their Bio-Forge. The symbiote emerges as a small, pulsating creature, its form varying depending on the enhancement it provides. A tube-like symbiote slithers over major joints, doubling the target’s strength, while a slug-like symbiote crawls over the eyes and ears, enhancing awareness and granting starlight vision. A body-frame symbiote encases the target, boosting fortitude and doubling all saves and resistances. A spider-like symbiote attaches to the skull, sharpening mental faculties and enhancing intelligence and willpower. Each symbiote clings tightly to its host, its organic texture warm and slightly pliable, merging seamlessly with the target’s physiology to deliver its enhancements.
Symbiotic Boost is an essential tool for the character to empower their allies, providing critical enhancements that can turn the tide of battle and ensure victory for the hive.

powers.name: Tactical Awareness

powers.notes:
Tactical Awareness grants the character an exceptional understanding of the battlefield, enabling them to anticipate enemy movements, position themselves strategically, and execute precise and efficient attacks. With each consecutive strike against the same target, the character becomes increasingly attuned to their opponent's weaknesses, enhancing both their attack accuracy and damage output.
When the character taps into Tactical Awareness, the battlefield unfolds before them with crystal clarity. Their senses sharpen, every detail of their surroundings becoming a potential advantage. The movements of their enemies slow as the character calculates the perfect strike, their blade finding the most vulnerable points with pinpoint accuracy. As the battle progresses, each attack against the same target feels more precise, more devastating, as if the character is peeling away their opponent’s defenses layer by layer. Onlookers see the character move with an almost preternatural sense of timing and positioning, each strike landing with methodical precision, as if every action has been foreseen and planned.
Tactical Awareness turns the character into a master strategist, where every move is part of a grand design to dismantle their enemies with surgical precision.

powers.name: Tactical Insight

Tactical Insight is an advanced ability that allows the character to enhance an ally’s cognitive functions, significantly improving their strategic thinking and decision-making abilities in the heat of battle. By sharpening the target’s mental acuity, the character empowers them to command and coordinate more effectively, making critical decisions with heightened clarity and precision.
When Tactical Insight is activated, the target’s mind becomes a beacon of strategic clarity. Thoughts that character once jumbled now align into a focused stream of tactical brilliance, allowing the target to process vast amounts of information with ease. A slight tingling sensation spreads across their scalp as their brain activity heightens, and their perception of the battlefield expands, enabling them to see patterns and opportunities that character previously hidden. The target’s eyes may glint with a newfound intensity, reflecting the rapid calculations and strategies forming in their mind. This enhanced cognitive state allows them to execute complex maneuvers, coordinate with allies, and outthink their opponents with effortless precision.
Tactical Insight is a crucial tool for ensuring that the hive’s leaders and key operatives can operate at peak efficiency, transforming them into master strategists capable of outmaneuvering and overwhelming their opponents. This ability exemplifies the character's role in optimizing the hive’s combat effectiveness through superior strategy and execution.

Tactical Retreat is a crucial ability that allows the character to swiftly reposition while leaving behind a decoy to distract enemies. This ability combines stealth, skill, and advanced gadgetry, ensuring that the character can evade danger and reappear at a more strategic location.

As the decoy continues to deceive, the character quietly moves to a new vantage point, preparing for an unknown attack. This seamless transition from one position to another leaves enemies confused and vulnerable, while the character prepares to strike again from a place of safety.
Tactical Retreat ensures that the character remains elusive and unpredictable, turning the battlefield into a deadly game of cat and mouse where the character always has the upper hand.

The armor appears to thicken and solidify, its surface taking on a molten, almost fluid-like texture that deflects and withstands the onslaught of thermal energy. The enhanced protection is not only physical but also integrated into the character’s systems, ensuring that both external and internal components remain unscathed by the blistering temperatures.

At the top, a bulbous, closed-mouth structure trembles with anticipation. As the character commands, the mouth snaps open, revealing a cluster of sharp, needle-like thorns. With a swift, precise motion, the Thorn Spitter launches a thorn with deadly accuracy, the projectile whistling through the air before embedding itself in the target. Each thorn is barbed, making it difficult and painful to remove, and the plant never ceases its assault, relentlessly firing again and again.
The Thorn Spitter’s relentless attacks and regenerative ability make it a constant, inescapable threat on the battlefield, forcing enemies to confront its persistent onslaught or be worn down by its ceaseless barrage.

powers.notes:
Thorn Wall is a formidable defensive ability that allows the character to summon a thick, impenetrable barrier of entwined thorns. This wall is a natural fortress, completely blocking sight and movement, and is resistant to most forms of attack. Only weapons or forces capable of cutting, slashing, chopping, or burning can effectively breach the Thorn Wall. Piercing, stabbing, and most ranged attacks (with the exception of fire-based weapons) are largely ineffective against this dense, living barricade.
When the Thorn Wall rises, the ground splits open to reveal a thick, tangled mass of dark, thorny vines that quickly interlock to form a towering barrier. Each thorn is sharp as a blade, glinting ominously in the light, while the vines themselves are tough and unyielding, creating a near-impenetrable defense. The wall hums with a quiet, menacing energy, and any attempt to breach it is met with automatic retaliation from the thorns, which lash out with vicious precision.
The Thorn Wall is more than just a barrier; it is a living shield that defends with the ferocity of nature itself, making it an essential tool for controlling the battlefield and protecting allies from harm.

powers.name: Thoughtweave
powers.effect: 1 target: subtle thought/emotion influence; [Persuasion(👁️)]^👁️
powers.notes:
Thoughtweave is a potent psychic ability that allows the character to subtly manipulate the thoughts and emotions of their targets, guiding decisions and actions toward the caster's desired outcomes. This ability is particularly effective for influencing others without direct confrontation, making it invaluable for subterfuge and psychological warfare.
When the character activates Thoughtweave, a subtle shift occurs in the air, almost imperceptible but palpably charged with intent. Those targeted feel a gentle tug at the edges of their thoughts, as if a warm, soothing voice is whispering in the back of their mind. The character’s eyes may narrow in concentration, their gaze piercing as they weave their mental tapestry. To onlookers, there is nothing overtly visible, yet the atmosphere seems to thicken with unspoken influence, as the character’s will subtly nudges and shapes the thoughts of those around them. The targets might feel a sudden clarity, a compelling urge to act in a way that feels entirely natural, unaware of the invisible strings guiding their decisions.
Thoughtweave turns the character into a master manipulator, bending the minds of others with a delicate touch, steering them toward actions that serve the caster’s hidden agenda.

powers.name: Transportal

powers.notes:
Transpoortal is a powerful ability that allows the character to summon two dark portals, one beneath a target and another at a chosen destination, enabling the character to relocate allies or enemies strategically. The target is disintegrated by the first portal and reassembled at the second, making this ability invaluable for both offensive and defensive maneuvers, whether during battle or in preparation for it.
As the character casts Transpoortal, a dark circle of void energy forms beneath the target, its surface shimmering like liquid obsidian. The portal then rises, consuming the target in a vortex of shadows, as if they are being pulled into the depths of the void. Simultaneously, the second portal opens at the destination, its surface rippling before spitting out the reassembled target. To those who witness the effect, it appears as though the character has the power to erase and redraw reality, bending the laws of physics to their will. The portals emit a soft, eerie hum that resonates in the bones, a reminder of the void’s unfathomable depths.
Transpoortal showcases the character’s ability to manipulate space and matter, allowing them to control the battlefield with surgical precision and relocate targets with the ease of a shadow moving across the ground.

powers.name: Unyielding Rage
powers.effect: Heal [Sk(🫀-2)] 1st Deg Wnds; all sqs cost MR(1) unless extreme terrain: Immune to Fear/Stun/Slow/Paralysis/Hold/Poisons/Disease
powers.notes:
Unyielding Rage empowers the character with an incredible surge of resilience, granting them immunity to various control effects such as stuns, fears, and slows, while also significantly boosting their healing capabilities. This ability reflects the character's indomitable spirit, allowing them to push through adversity and continue fighting with relentless ferocity, no matter the odds.
When Unyielding Rage is activated, the character becomes enveloped in a palpable aura of raw power. Their wounds begin to close almost instantly, skin knitting together with supernatural speed as a faint, red glow pulses from within. Their eyes blaze with unyielding determination, and their movements become more deliberate, unstoppable. The very air around them seems to crackle with energy, and those nearby can feel the heat of their fury. To onlookers, the character appears as an unstoppable juggernaut, moving through the battlefield with a singular purpose, shrugging off blows that would fell lesser warriors.
At its peak, Unyielding Rage transforms the character into a near-invincible force, capable of enduring even the most brutal assaults without faltering. This ability, when combined with their lycanthropic powers, ensures that the character remains a relentless and fearsome presence on the battlefield, unbreakable and unstoppable.

powers.name: Vampiric
powers.effect: Drain Vit from victim to self: [Resist(✨)]^✨ for Wnds & Healing of [Drain(✨-1)] Ignores armor. No effect on non-living.
powers.notes:
This power allows sorcists to drain victims' Vit away and add it to their own (or later an ally). Vampiric is a no-slide form of healing.
If the victim is unwilling, the sorcist must Atk^Def. Drain is the amount of Wnds caused and is equal to the amount of healing done. One creative use of Vampiric is to suck health from a tank or other regenerative or high health target to help heal a weaker target (once the Ver\# is high enough for this, of course).
*Vampiric* ignores armor, but does not affect non-living beings.

powers.name: Vanish
powers.effect: If unseen; become hidden; you may immediately move up to d4 sq toward a visible shadow

powers.name: Veil of Beauty

powers.name: Vengeance Claw
powers.effect: Tight radius AoE: [Atk/Dmg(💪)/(💪)] vs all foes who attacked you (previous or this rnd).
powers.notes:
Vengeance Claw is a fearsome ability that allows the character to retaliate against any foe who dares to strike them. With this ability, the character channels their primal rage into a flurry of counterattacks, targeting all enemies within range who have attacked them in the previous round or so far in the current round. The speed and ferocity of these retaliatory strikes make Vengeance Claw a devastating tool for punishing aggression.
When Vengeance Claw is activated, the character becomes a blur of motion, their claws flashing through the air with blinding speed. Each strike is accompanied by a savage snarl, and the sound of claws tearing through flesh and armor fills the air. The character's movements are so fast that they seem to be in multiple places at once, their form flickering as they lash out at every enemy within reach. To onlookers, it is as though the character has become a living storm of violence, their every movement a deadly strike against those who have wronged them.
At its height, Vengeance Claw serves as both a powerful deterrent and a lethal response to any who would dare challenge the character. This ability, especially when combined with their lycanthropic transformations, ensures that the character remains a nearly untouchable force on the battlefield, capable of delivering swift and brutal retribution to any who stand in their way.

powers.name: Verdant Parry
powers.effect: Shield/Block vs melee [Blk/AR(✨)/(🧥)]; on failure, PC still gets normal [Dod/AR(🏃)/(🏃)]
powers.notes:
Verdant Parry is a defensive ability of the character that utilizes the power of nature to protect against incoming melee attacks. By seeding and accelerating the growth of vines on a designated target, the character creates a sparse web of protruding, snake-like vines. These living defenses instinctively move to intercept and parry any melee strikes aimed at the protected target.
As the vines grow, they wrap around the arms and torso of the target, their smooth, green surface bristling with anticipation. Each time an enemy strikes, the vines react with lightning speed, darting out to deflect the blow with surprising force. The sound of rustling leaves and the faint creak of wood accompanies each parry, as the vines act as an extension of the character’s will, protecting their charge from harm.
Verdant Parry ensures that the character’s allies are shielded from the most direct attacks, turning the very plants they nurture into vigilant guardians that stand ready to defend against any threat.

powers.name: Verdant Strider
powers.effect: Vines carry at MR; climb/swim/lift/suspend at MR(*.5) via [Acrobatics(🏃)] or [Athletics(💪)].
powers.notes:
Verdant Strider is an extraordinary ability that embodies the character's deep connection with nature, allowing them to traverse the environment with unparalleled ease and grace. Through this ability, the character summons and controls powerful, living vines that extend from their armor and body, carrying them swiftly across the terrain. These vines can lift, suspend, and propel the character at remarkable speeds, whether climbing vertical surfaces, swimming through water, or moving across challenging landscapes.
When Verdant Strider is activated, the character becomes a blur of motion as the living vines respond instantly to their will. The vines emerge from the armor, twisting and weaving through the air with incredible agility. As they wrap around the character, the vines lift them effortlessly, allowing them to glide across treetops, scale sheer cliffs, or dive into rivers with fluid grace. The scene is one of seamless harmony with nature, as the character moves as though they are one with the very elements they command, their passage marked by the soft rustling of leaves and the faint glow of bioluminescence.
Verdant Strider showcases the character's mastery over the living forces of nature, making them an agile and adaptable guardian of the verdant realms.

powers.notes:
Vine Snare is a versatile and powerful ability that enables the character to summon robust, enhanced vines from the earth, ensnaring and immobilizing their enemies. These vines, imbued with the strength of nature, are capable of binding even the most agile and powerful foes, rendering them vulnerable and significantly reducing their combat effectiveness. Vine Snare serves as an essential tool for crowd control, allowing the character to dominate the battlefield by neutralizing key threats and restricting enemy movement.
When Vine Snare is activated, the ground beneath the enemy begins to rumble and crack, as thick, gnarled vines burst forth from the earth. These vines are dark green, almost black, and covered in sharp, thorny protrusions. They move with a life of their own, writhing and coiling around the target's legs and arms with surprising speed and strength. The vines tighten their grip, digging into flesh and armor alike, making escape nearly impossible. The more the target struggles, the tighter the vines constrict, their rough texture scraping and tearing at the skin. The scent of crushed leaves and damp earth fills the air as the vines hold the target in place, rendering them powerless to attack or defend effectively.
Vine Snare allows the character to exert complete control over the battlefield, neutralizing threats with nature’s unyielding grip and turning the tide of combat in their favor.

Certain versions also create complete immunity to certain Sorce abilities as listed. **Slide**: Wounds do slide normally.

powers.name: Void Pulses
powers.effect: 1 target; auto-hit target for [Dmg(✨)]
powers.notes:
Void Pulses is an ability that unleashes a rapid barrage of marble-sized orbs filled with void energy. These orbs are swift and unfailingly accurate, making them perfect for guaranteed hits in combat. Upon contact, each orb disintegrates a portion of the target, causing consistent wounding damage. Void Pulses is a deadly tool in the character’s arsenal, ensuring that every strike lands and every enemy suffers the void’s wrath.
When Void Pulses is activated, the character raises their hand, and a series of dark, shimmering orbs begin to materialize in the air around them. These orbs, each no larger than a marble, pulse with an ominous light, their surfaces flickering with contained void energy. With a flick of the character’s wrist, the orbs shoot forth like bullets, streaking through the air with a speed that defies the eye. Upon impact, the orbs dissolve into the target, leaving behind small but devastating wounds that bleed with the energy of the void. To onlookers, it appears as though the character has summoned the very essence of destruction, unleashing it in a concentrated, relentless barrage that tears through the fabric of their enemies.
Void Pulses is a relentless and precise manifestation of the character’s power, ensuring that every attack finds its mark and leaves nothing but devastation in its wake.

powers.name: Void Step
powers.effect: Teleport up to 5 sq in any direction within sight, OR  [Sk(✨)]^Atk to phase so Attack passes through caster with no effect
powers.notes:
Void Step is a versatile ability that allows the character to harness the power of the void to traverse short distances instantaneously. By stepping into a rift, the character can teleport across the battlefield, gaining a tactical advantage or evading incoming threats. This ability makes the character difficult to pin down, adding an element of unpredictability to their movements in combat.
As the character activates Void Step, a dark rift opens beneath their feet, swirling with void energy. In the blink of an eye, the character steps into the rift, their form dissolving into shadow before reappearing at their chosen destination. The rift closes behind them with a soft whoosh, leaving only a faint ripple in the air where they once stood. To those watching, the character seems to vanish and reappear as if by magic, their movements fluid and impossible to predict. The character’s presence on the battlefield becomes a blur of dark energy, a ghostly figure that flickers in and out of existence, making them nearly impossible to catch or corner.
Void Step turns the character into a master of evasion and tactical positioning, allowing them to move through the battlefield with the fluidity of a shadow and the precision of a predator.

powers.name: Void Strike
powers.effect: [Atk/Dmg(✨)/(✨)] and [Sk(✨)]^🫀 or target displaced up to 3 sq (caster choice; not in air).
powers.notes:
Void Strike is a powerful technique that allows the character to use their Rift Blade to open small void rifts, teleporting struck targets short distances. This ability provides unparalleled battle management, enabling the character to reposition enemies strategically on the battlefield, avoiding repeat attacks and creating opportunities for devastating follow-ups.
When Void Strike is unleashed, the Rift Blade slices through the air, creating a shimmering rift where the blade makes contact. This rift pulses with void energy, and within an instant, the target is enveloped in a burst of shadowy tendrils, vanishing from their original location. The void rift briefly flickers, showing glimpses of the target’s new location before sealing shut with a resonant snap. To onlookers, it appears as though the character has bent space itself, displacing their foe with a mere flick of their wrist, leaving their enemy disoriented and vulnerable.
Void Strike demonstrates the character's mastery over the fabric of reality, using the Rift Blade not only to damage but to control the battlefield, placing their enemies exactly where they want them.

powers.name: Void Vanquish
powers.effect: [Sk(✨)]^✨ -> Vanquishes to the void, When return have 1/2 Vit, Max of 1 Vanquished
powers.notes:
Void Vanquish is a potent ability that enhances the character's Void Staff, allowing them to create a rift in spacetime and banish enemies into the void. This ability temporarily removes targets from the battlefield, isolating them in void space where they are completely cut off from the ongoing conflict. Upon their return, the targets are significantly weakened, their vitality halved, making them easier to defeat and turning the tide of battle in the character’s favor.
When Void Vanquish is cast, the Void Staff pulses with a surge of dark energy, and the air around the target begins to warp and distort. A rift in spacetime opens, a swirling vortex of shadows that pulls the target into the void with a sudden, forceful drag. The target is enveloped in darkness, their form fading into the swirling void until they vanish completely from sight. The rift then snaps shut with a resonant boom, leaving only a faint afterimage of where the target once stood. To those witnessing the spell, it appears as though the character has reached out and plucked the target from reality itself, casting them into the void where time and space lose all meaning. The battlefield falls silent for a brief moment, the absence of the target a stark reminder of the character's power.
Void Vanquish is a terrifying demonstration of the character's mastery over the void, removing enemies from the field with a mere thought and returning them weakened and vulnerable, ready to be vanquished once and for all.

magic_items.name: AegisColar
magic_items.effect: Store or retrieve armor at press of a button; plates deploy via internal transporters.
magic_items.notes:
The AegisColar is a sophisticated piece of gear designed to provide instant access to protective armor with the simple press of a button. This half-collar, worn around the back of the neck, can store an entire set of armor by breaking it down into individual plates and storing them within the collar itself. When needed, the collar swiftly reassembles and deploys the armor over the wearer’s body, providing immediate protection. The process is efficient, though it does produce a slight noise as the plates are fitted together during the assembly and disassembly.
The AegisColar resembles the regal collars of ancient Egypt, but with a futuristic twist. Its sleek, metallic surface gleams with a polished sheen, catching the light as it rests subtly on the back of the neck. When activated, the collar emits a faint hum, and the stored armor begins to unfurl from within. Plates glide smoothly over the wearer’s body, forming a seamless protective layer. The entire process is a marvel of technology, as each plate locks into place with precision, creating a visual spectacle akin to watching an intricate puzzle assemble itself. The slight clinking of metal as the plates fit together adds to the sense of mechanical elegance, making the transformation feel both powerful and awe-inspiring.
Unleash the power of instant protection with the AegisColar, the ultimate fusion of ancient style and cutting-edge technology, ensuring you're always ready for battle at the press of a button.
Effects
\-- Half collar stores/returns armor at press of a button.
\-- Armor rolls out/in as plates via internal transporters.

magic_items.name: AeroJet Thruster
magic_items.effect: Atmospheric flight: 100 ft/Rnd vertical, MR(24) horizontal; 1 hr on Nova-Cores, recharges 1 min flight per 10 min.
magic_items.notes:
The AeroJet Thruster is an advanced propulsion system worn as a backpack, designed specifically for atmospheric flight. Utilizing a combination of powerful turbofans and a minijet propulsion system, it enables the wearer to achieve vertical lift and horizontal movement. The pack is controlled through a pair of retractable arms equipped with joysticks, allowing for precise maneuverability in flight. However, its functionality is limited to environments with an atmosphere, rendering it ineffective in space. The pack is powered by Nova-Cores, providing up to one hour of continuous operation before needing to recharge. The Nova-Core recharges the pack at a rate of one minute of flight time for every ten minutes of downtime.
The AeroJet Thruster is a sleek and robust piece of equipment, with a design that exudes both power and efficiency. The backpack is crafted from lightweight, durable materials, its surface smooth and aerodynamic. When activated, the turbofans emit a low hum that gradually intensifies as the minijet engines ignite, propelling the user into the air. The retractable control arms extend smoothly, bringing the joysticks into the user’s hands, ready for immediate maneuvering. As the thruster lifts off, the sensation of acceleration is exhilarating, with the world below quickly shrinking as the user soars effortlessly through the sky. The soft glow of the Nova-Core, visible through a small panel on the pack, pulsates rhythmically, a visual testament to the advanced technology within.
With the AeroJet Thruster, take to the skies and leave the ground far behind—where your only limit is the horizon.
Effects
\-- Backpack with turbofans/minijet for atmospheric flight (useless in space).
\-- Lifts up to 100 ft/Rnd, horizontal MR(24).
\-- Retractable arms with joysticks for control.
\-- Operates 1 hr on Nova-Cores, recharges 1 min flight per 10 min.

magic_items.name: Anti-Grav Harness
magic_items.effect: Enc(+150); eliminates 1 Wpn Enc(250) or less; Max MR lesser of (6 or MR(-1)); articulated arm mounts heavy weapon with buoyant support.
magic_items.notes:
The Anti-Grav Harness is a sophisticated suspensor belt that provides unparalleled support and versatility for its wearer. This large metal ring, equipped with adjustable expansion slides, comfortably fits around the midsection of most beings. Once secured with eight inward-extending pins, the harness activates its anti-gravity field, allowing the user to hover effortlessly as they move. The harness has additional storage options provided by various hooks, fasteners, and compartments integrated into the belt’s design. Moreover, if the user’s armor is rigid, the harness can integrate directly with the armor. An articulated arm, which can mount a single heavy item like a cannon, extends from the belt and offers buoyant support, making even the heaviest weapons feel nearly weightless. The arm’s internal technology ensures that the user’s balance remains stable, despite the additional load. However, the harness does impose a movement restriction.
Visually, the Anti-Grav Harness is an impressive piece of engineering, its robust metal ring gleaming with a polished finish. This implant allows the user to penetrate surfaces, revealing hidden objects, spaces or things behind them. The depth of vision depends on the material’s density, with greater clarity through lighter substances such as cloth or thin walls, and more resistance when attempting to see through denser materials like stone or metal. This implant is particularly valuable for reconnaissance, security, and tactical operations, offering the wearer a significant advantage in environments where unseen obstacles or threats may lurk.
Visually, the Cyber X-Ray Eye is a marvel of sleek, futuristic design, seamlessly integrated with the user’s existing cyber eye. When activated, the eye emits a faint, bluish glow that intensifies as the X-ray vision engages, casting a subtle light across the surface being scanned. The surrounding area may appear slightly distorted, as if the air itself is rippling in response to the eye’s penetrating gaze. As the user focuses, the glow sharpens into a precise beam, illuminating hidden details beneath layers of material. The experience of using the Cyber X-Ray Eye is akin to peeling back the layers of reality, revealing a hidden world that exists just out of sight. The sensation is both thrilling and empowering, giving the user a sense of omniscience as they uncover secrets that would otherwise remain concealed.
Unlock the unseen with the Cyber X-Ray Eye, and gain the power to see beyond the surface, revealing hidden truths and gaining the ultimate advantage in any situation.
Effects
\-- Cyber implant requiring existing cyber eye.
\-- X-ray vision with Sk() open-ended roll based on material density

magic_items.notes:
Cyber-Legs, Speed are a cutting-edge full-leg replacement designed for individuals seeking enhanced mobility and speed. These cybernetic limbs replace both legs entirely, including necessary reinforcements to the pelvic area to handle the increased weight and torque generated by the advanced mechanics. Constructed with a metal alloy core wrapped in a durable vulcanized rubber exterior, these legs are built to endure extreme conditions, including the heat from soft molten metal. The internal servos operate with remarkable quietness, ensuring smooth and efficient movement. Designed for speed, these cyber-legs significantly boost the wearer’s movement rate and agility, making them an ideal choice for those who require quick and nimble responses in high-stakes environments.
The visual design of the Cyber-Legs, Speed is both sleek and robust, exuding a sense of raw power combined with high-tech elegance. The metal alloy core gleams beneath the matte, textured finish of the vulcanized rubber, giving the legs a rugged yet polished appearance. The feet are equipped with specialized tracks and retractable claws, providing superior grip on various surfaces, from slick urban streets to soft, uneven terrain. When in motion, the legs exhibit a fluid, almost graceful movement, with the servos operating so silently that they seem to glide effortlessly. The enhanced leap and jump capabilities add a dynamic edge, allowing the user to vault over obstacles with ease. The overall effect is one of relentless precision and strength, as these cyber-legs transform the wearer into a veritable force of nature.
Elevate your performance with Cyber-Legs, Speed, where every step is a leap towards unparalleled agility and power, ensuring you outpace and outmaneuver anything that stands in your way.
Effects
\-- Full leg replacement for speed and agility; metal alloy core, vulcanized rubber exterior.

Harness the raw power of Cyber-Legs, Strength, and experience a level of physical dominance that will leave your foes trembling, as you crush obstacles and opponents alike with every step.

magic_items.name: CyberGuards
magic_items.effect: [AR(🧥+2)]^Blunt/Crush/Fall; stacks with OstealSteel for [AR(🧥+3)]
magic_items.notes:
CyberGuards are a revolutionary cybernetic implant designed to enhance the body's natural defense against blunt force trauma. These implants consist of thousands of nail-shaped shock absorbers that are meticulously embedded beneath the skin and anchored to the underlying bone structure. By distributing the impact of blunt forces more effectively than tissue alone, CyberGuards significantly reduce the damage from crushing, falling, or any blunt weapon strikes. The result is a system where the user might only experience a series of round, circular bruises instead of severe injuries. When combined with SteelOsteal enhancements, the protective benefits are amplified even further, making the wearer incredibly resilient to blunt trauma.
Visually, the presence of CyberGuards is almost undetectable, as the implants are discreetly hidden beneath the skin. However, upon closer inspection or under certain lighting, a subtle pattern of faintly raised circles might be visible, hinting at the advanced technology beneath. The skin over these areas feels slightly firmer to the touch, a testament to the shock absorbers working beneath the surface. During an impact, there is a noticeable dampening effect, as if the force is being absorbed and dispersed by an invisible shield. This gives the user a sense of invulnerability, as they withstand blows that would incapacitate an ordinary person. The combination of advanced materials and precise engineering results in a seamless integration that enhances both the durability and functionality of the user's body.
Equip yourself with CyberGuards and turn every hit into a mere bruise, ensuring that no amount of blunt force can slow you down as you stand strong against the harshest of impacts.
Effects
\-- Cyber implant of shock absorbers under the skin.

magic_items.name: D-Carbine
magic_items.effect: [Atk/Dmg(👁️)/(👁️)] and the dimensional ball transforms into [d4] 1-pile of rubbel [Stuck(✨)]^💪, 2-flaming coals [d4] fire affliction, 3-sticky tar MR(/2) affliction, 4-grenade extra [Atk/Dmg(✨)/(✨)] 1r
magic_items.notes:
The D-Carbine is a highly advanced and unpredictable weapon that uses dimensional technology to fire projectiles with transformative properties. This gun, while similar in design to a standard Blaster Carbine, differentiates itself by shooting two-inch diameter dimensional balls that, after traveling a short distance, transform into a variety of unpredictable objects or entities. These transformations can range from harmless ice cubes to deadly steel beams or even a fully operational combat mech. The randomness of each shot adds an element of chaos, making the D-Carbine both a powerful and a potentially dangerous tool in combat, especially when the results are unknown until the moment of impact.
In appearance, the D-Carbine exudes an air of mystery and futuristic elegance. Its sleek, dark metallic body is accentuated with subtle glowing lines that pulse with energy, hinting at the advanced technology within. The gun feels solid and well-balanced in the hand, with a smooth grip and a streamlined design that speaks to its high-tech nature. When fired, the D-Carbine emits a soft hum as the dimensional ball is discharged, leaving a faint trail of light in its wake. The anticipation builds as the ball travels, knowing that within seconds it will morph into something entirely unexpected. The visual spectacle of a dimensional ball transforming mid-air into a mass of rubble, a burning log, or even an android is both awe-inspiring and terrifying, making the D-Carbine a weapon that commands respect and caution.
Embrace the unpredictability of the D-Carbine, where every shot is an adventure, and the battlefield becomes your canvas for dimensional chaos and destruction.
